Vizman sheosin al hariyya hayu mechashshevin veyodin shaa sheyyitkabbetz bo hayyareach im hachamma bedikduk harebe kederech shehaitztagninin osin. kede leda im yerae hayyareach o lo yerae. utechillat oto hacheshbon hu hacheshbon shemmechashshevin oto bekeruv veyodin sheat kibbutzam belo dikduk ella bemahalacham haemtzai hu hannikra molad. veikkere hacheshbon shemmechashshevin bizman sheen sham bet din sheyyikbeu bo al hariyya vehu cheshbon sheanu mechashshevin hayyom hu hannikra ibbur: 
Hayyom vehallayla arba veesrim shaot bechol zeman. shetem esre bayyom ushetem esre ballayla. vehashshaa mechulleket leelef ushemonim chalakim. velamma chilleku hashshaa leminyan ze. lefi shemminyan ze yesh bo chatzi urevia usheminit ushelish ushetut vetesha vechomesh veissur. veharebe chalakim yesh lechol ellu hashshemot: 
Mishsheyyitkabbetz hayyareach vehachamma lefi cheshbon ze ad sheyyitkabbetzu paam sheniyya bemahalacham haemtzai. tisha veesrim yom ushetem esre shaot miyyom sheloshim mittechillat lelo. usheva meot ushelosha vetishim chalakim mishsheat shelosh esre. veze hu hazzeman shebben kol molad umolad veze hu chadshah shel levana: 
Shana shel levana im tihye shenem asar chodesh mechodashim ellu yihye kelalah shelosh meot yom vearbaa vachamishshim yom ushemone shaot ushemone meot veshishsha veshivim chalakim. veim tihye meubberet vetihye hashshana shelosha asar chodesh yihye kelalah shelosh meot ushemonim ushelosha yom veachat veesrim shaot vachamesh meot vetisha ushemonim chalakim. ushenat hachamma hi shelosh meot chamishsha veshishshim yom veshesh shaot. nimtza tosefet shenat hachamma al shenat hallevana asara yamim veachat veesrim shaot umatayim vearbaa chalakim: 
Keshettashlich yeme chodesh hallevana shiva shiva shehen yeme hashshavua. yishshaer yom echad ushetem esre shaot usheva meot ushelosha vetishim chalakim. siman lahem 13 793. vezo hi sheerit chodesh hallevana. vechen keshettashlich yeme shenat hallevana shiva shiva. im shana peshuta hi yishshaer mimmenna arbaa yamim ushemone shaot ushemone meot veshishsha veshivim chalakim. siman lahem 12 876. vezo hi sheerit shana peshuta. veim shana meebberet hi tihye sheeritah chamishsha yamim veachat veesrim shaot vachamesh meot vetisha ushemonim chalakim. siman lahem 26 589: 
Kesheyyihye immecha yadua molad chodesh min hechodashim vetosif alav 13 793 yetze molad sheacharav. veteda bee ze yom mime hashshavua uvee zo shaa uvechamma chalakim yihye: 
Ketzad. hare shehaya molad nisan beechad beshabbat bechamesh shaot bayyom umea veshiva chalakim siman lahem 113. keshettosif alav sheerit chodesh hallevana vehu 13 793. yetze molad iyyar belel shelishi chamesh shaot ballayla utesha meot chalakim. siman lahem 8 900. veal derech zo ad sof haolam chodesh achar chodesh: 
Vechen kesheyyihye immecha yadua molad shana zo vetosif sheeritah al yeme hammolad. im peshuta hi sheerit happeshuta veim meubberet hi sheerit hameubberet. yetze lecha molad shana shelleachareha. vechen shana achar shana ad sof haolam. vehammolad harishon shemmimmennu tatchil hu molad shehaya bashshana harishona shel yetzira. vehu haya belel sheni chamesh shaot ballayla umatayim vearbaa chalakim. siman lahem 211 umimmennu hu techillat hacheshbon: 
Bechol hacheshbonot haellu shetteda mehen hammolad. keshettosif sheerit im sheerit. kesheyyitkabbetz min hachalakim elef ushemonim tashlim shaa achat vetosif otah leminyan hashshaot. uchesheyyitkabbetz min hashshaot arba veesrim tashlim yom vetosif mimmennu leminyan hayyamim. uchesheyyitkabbetz min hayyamim yoter al shiva tashlich shiva min hamminyan vetanniach hashshear. sheen anu mechashshevin leda minyan hayyamim ella leda bee ze yom mime hashshavua uvee ze shaa vee ze chelek yihye hammolad: 
Kol tesha esre shana sheyyihyu mehen sheva shanim meebbarot ushetem esre peshutot nikra machazor. velamma samachnu al minyan ze. shebbizman sheatta mekabbetz minyan yeme shetem esre shana peshutot vesheva meebbarot usheotehen vechelkehen vetashlim kol elef ushemonim chalakim shaa. vechol arba veesrim shaot yom. vetosif leminyan hayyamim. timtza hakkol tesha esre shana mishshene hachamma shekkol shana mehen shelosh meot vachamishsha veshishshim yom veshesh shaot beshave. velo yishshaer mimminyan yeme hachamma bechol tesha esre shana chutz mishshaa achat vearba meot ushemonim vachamishsha chalakim. siman lahem 486: 
Nimtza bemachazor shehu kaze hechodashim kullam chadshe hallevana vehashshanim shene hachamma. vehashsheva shanim hameubbarot shebbechol machazor umachazor lefi cheshbon ze hem shana shelishit min hammachazor veshishshit usheminit ushenat achat esre ushenat arba esre ushenat sheva esre ushenat 19. siman lahem 17 11 14 17 19: 
Keshettekabbetz sheerit kol shana mishshetem esre shana happeshutot shehi 12 876. usheerit kol shana mishsheva shanim hameubbarot shehi 26 589. vetashlich hakkol shiva shiva yishshaer shene yamim veshesh esre shaot vachamesh meot vachamishsha vetishim chalakim. siman lahem 18 595. veze hu sheerit hammachazor: 
Kesheyyihye lecha yadua molad techillat machazor vetosif alav 18 595. yatza lecha techillat hammachazor sheacharav vechen molad kol machazor umachazor ad sof haolam. uchevar amarnu shemmolad techillat hammachazor harishon haya 241. umolad hashshana hu molad tishre shel otah hashshana: 
Uvadderech hazzot teda molad kol shana veshana shettirtze. umolad kol chodesh vechodesh shettirtze. mishshanim sheavru o mishshanim sheatidim lavo. ketzad. tikkach shene yetzira sheavru vegamru vetaase otam machazorin shel tesha esre tesha esre shana ad tishre shel otah hashshana. veteda minyan hammachazorin sheavru uminyan hashshanim sheavru mimmachazor sheadayin lo nishlam. vetikkach lechol machazor umachazor 18 595. ulechol shana veshana peshuta mishshene hammachazor shello nishlam 12 876. ulechol shana meebberet 26 589. utekabbetz hakkol vetashlim hachalakim shaot. vetashlim hashshaot yamim. vehayyamim tashlichem shiva shiva. vehannishar min hayyamim umin hashshaot vehachalakim hu molad shana habbaa shettirtze leda moladah: 
Molad hashshana sheyyetze becheshbon ze hu molad rosh chodesh tishre. ucheshettosif alav 13 793 yetze molad marcheshvan. ucheshettosif al marcheshvan 13 793 yetze molad kislev. vechen lechol chodesh vechodesh ze achar ze ad sof haolam:

En kovin leolam rosh chodesh tishre lefi cheshbon ze lo beechad beshabbat velo birvii beshabbat velo beerev shabbat. siman lahem 11. ella kesheyyihye molad tishre beechad mishshelosha yamim haellu kovin rosh chodesh bayyom shelleacharav. ketzad. hare shehaya hammolad beechad beshabbat kovin rosh chodesh tishre yom sheni. veim haya hammolad birvii kovin rosh chodesh yom chamishi. veim haya hammolad beshishshi kovin rosh chodesh bishvii: 
Vechen im yihye hammolad bachatzi hayyom o lemala mechatzi hayyom kovin rosh chodesh bayyom shelleacharav. ketzad. hare shehaya hammolad beyom sheni beshesh shaot bayyom o yeter al shesh shaot kovin rosh chodesh bishlishi. veim yihye hammolad kodem chatzi hayyom afillu bechelek echad kovin rosh hachodesh beoto yom hammolad atzmo. vehu shello yihye oto hayyom mime 11: 
Kesheyyihye hammolad bachatzi hayyom o achar chatzot veyiddache layyom shelleacharav. im yihye yom shelleacharav mime 11 hare ze nidche leshelleacharav veyihye rosh hachodesh kavua bishlishi miyyom hammolad. ketzad. hare sheyyihye hammolad beshabbat bachatzot siman 25 kovin rosh hachodesh bashshana shemmoladah kaze besheni beshabbat. vechen im haya hammolad bishlishi bachatzot o achar chatzot kovin rosh hachodesh bachamishi beshabbat: 
Molad tishre sheyyatza becheshbon ze belel shelishi betesha shaot ballayla umatayim vearbaa chalakim mishshaa asirit simanah 12 204. o yoter al ze. im hayta shana peshuta dochin et rosh hachodesh veen kovim oto bishlishi beshana zo ella bachamishi beshabbat: 
Vechen im yatza molad tishre beyom sheni beshalosh shaot beyom vetkft chalakim mishshaa reviit. simanah 17 589. o yeter al ken. im hayta otah hashshana motzae hameubberet shehayta hashshana hassemucha lah sheavra meubberet. en kovin rosh hachodesh besheni beshana zo ella bishlishi: 
Haya molad hashshana happeshuta sheamarnu shettiddache lachamishi pachot chelek echad. kegon sheyyatza simanah 12 203 o pachot mizze. kovin otah bishlishi. vechen im haya molad motzae haibbur beyom sheni pachot chelek. kegon shehaya simanah 17 588 o pachot mizze. kovin otah besheni. nimtza derech keviat rosh chodesh tishre lefi cheshbon ze kach hu. tachshov veteda hammolad bee ze yom yihye uvechamma shaot min hayyom o min hallayla uvechamma chalakim min hashshaa. veyom hammolad hu yom hakkevia leolam. ella im ken haya beechad beshabbat o birvii o beerev shabbat. o im haya hammolad bachatzot hayyom o achar chatzot. o im haya 206 chalakim mishshaa asirit millel shelishi o yoter al ze vehayta shana peshuta. o shehaya hammolad 591 chalakim mishshaa reviit miyyom sheni vehayta hashshana peshuta sheachar hameebberet. sheim yeera beechad mearbaa devarim haellu en kovin beyom hammolad ella bayyom shelleacharav o shelleachar acharav kadderech shebbearnu: 
Umippene ma en kovin becheshbon ze bime 11. lefi shehacheshbon hazze hu lekibbutz hayyareach vehashshemesh behilluchah haemtzai lo bammakom haamitti kemo shehodanu. lefichach asu yom kevia veyom dechiyya kede lifgoa beyom kibbutz haamitti. ketzad. bishlishi kovin birvii dochin. bachamishi kovin beshishshi dochin. beshabbat kovin echad beshabbat dochin. besheni kovin: 
Veikkar shear haarba dechiyyot ellu hu ze haikkar sheamarnu shehacheshbon hazze bemahalach emtzai. ureaya laddavar shehammolad yihye belel shelishi veyiddache lachamishi peamim rabbot lo yerae yareach belel chamishi velo belel shishshi mikkelal shello nitkabbetzu hashshemesh vehayyareach kibbutz amitti ella bachamishi:

Chadsha shel levana tisha veesrim yom umechetza vetshtzg chalakim kemo shebbearnu. vei efshar lomar sherosh hachodesh yihye bemiktzat hayyom ad sheyyihye miktzat hayyom mechodesh sheavar umiktzato mehabba. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 11 20)</small> "ad chodesh yamim" mippi hashshemua lamdu sheyyamim atta mechashshev lechodesh vei atta mechashshev shaot: 
Lefichach osin chadshe hallevana mehen chodesh chaser umehem chodesh male. chodesh chaser tisha veesrim yom bilvad veaf al pi shechadshah shel levana yeter al ze beshaot. vechodesh male mishsheloshim yom veaf al pi shechadshah shel levana pachot mizze beshaot. kede shello lechashshev shaot bachodesh ella yamim shelemim: 
Illu haya chadshah shel levana tisha veesrim yom umechetza bilvad hayu kol hashshanim chodesh male vechodesh chaser. veyihyu yeme shenat hallevana 354, shishsha chodashim chaserim veshishsha chodashim meleim. aval mippene hachalakim sheyyesh bechol chodesh vechodesh yoter al chatzi hayyom yitkabbetz mehen shaot veyamim. ad sheyyihyu miktzat hashshanim chodashim chaserim yoter al hammeleim uvemiktzat hashshanim chodashim meleim yoter al hachaserim: 
Yom sheloshim leolam osin oto rosh chodesh becheshbon ze. im haya hachodesh sheavar chaser yihye yom sheloshim rosh chodesh habba. veim yihye hachodesh sheavar male yihye yom sheloshim rosh chodesh hoil umiktzato rosh chodesh. veyihye tashlum hachodesh hammale sheavar. veyihye yom echad usheloshim rosh hachodesh habba umimmennu hu hamminyan. vehu yom hakkevia. ulefichach osin rashe chodashim becheshbon ze chodesh echad yom echad bilvad vechodesh echad shene yamim: 
Seder hechodashim hammeleim vehachaserim lefi cheshbon ze kach hu. tishre leolam male. vetevet leolam chaser. umittevet veelach echad male veechad chaser al hasseder. ketzad. tevet chaser shevat male. adar chaser nisan male. iyyar chaser sivan male. tammuz chaser av male. elul chaser. uveshana hameubberet adar rishon male vaadar sheni chaser: 
Nisharu shene hechodashim shehen marcheshvan vechislev. peamim yihyu shenehem meleim ufeamim yihyu shenehem chaserim ufeamim yihye marcheshvan chaser vechislev male. veshana sheyyihyu bah shene chodashim ellu meleim hi shennikreu chodasheha shelemim. veshana sheyyihyu bah shene chodashim ellu chaserim nikreu chodasheha chaserin. veshana sheyyihyu bah marcheshvan chaser vechislev male nikreu chodasheha kesidran: 
Derech yediat hashshana im chodasheha meleim o chaserin o kesidran lefi cheshbon ze kach hu. teda techilla yom shennikba bo rosh hashshana shettirtze leda siddur chodasheha kemo shebbearnu beferek shevii. veteda yom sheyyikkava bo rosh hashshana shelleachareha. utechashshev minyan hayyamim shebbenehen chutz miyyom hakkevia shel zo veshel zo. im timtza benehen shene yamim yihyu chadshe hashshana chaserin. veim timtza benehem shelosha yamim yihyu kesidran. veim timtza benehem arbaa yamim yihyu chadshe hashshana shelemim: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayta hashshana shettirtze leda siddur chodasheha peshuta. aval im hayta meebberet. im timtza ben yom keviatah uven yom keviat shana shelleachareha arbaa yamim yihyu chadshe otah shana hameubberet chaserim. veim timtza benehem chamishsha yamim yihyu kesidran. veim timtza benehem shishsha yihyu shelemim: 
Ketzad. hare sheratzinu leda siddur chadshe shana zo. vehaya rosh hashshana bachamishi vehi peshuta verosh hashshana shelleachareha besheni beshabbat. nimtza benehen shelosha yamim. yadanu sheshshana zo chodasheha kesidran. veillu haya rosh hashshana shelleachareha bishlishi hayu chadshe hashshana zo shelemim. veillu haya rosh hashshana beshana zo beshabbat uvashshana shelleachareha bishlishi beshabbat hayu chadshe shana zo chaserin. veal derech zo techashshev lashshana hameubberet kemo shebbearnu: 
Yesh sham simanin shettismoch alehem kede shello tite becheshbon siddur chadshe hashshana vehen benuyin al ikkere ze hacheshbon vehakkeviot vehaddechiyyot shebbearnu darkam. veellu hen. kol shana sheyyihye rosh hashshana bah bashshelishi tihye leolam kesidran lefi cheshbon ze. ben peshuta ben meubberet. veim yihye rosh hashshana beshabbat o besheni lo tihye kesidran leolam ben bifshuta ben bimebberet. veim yihye rosh hashshana bachamishi. im peshuta hi i efshar sheyyihyu chodasheha chaserim lefi cheshbon ze. veim meubberet hi i efshar sheyyihyu chodasheha kesidran lefi cheshbon ze:

Shennat hachamma yesh mechachme yisrael sheomrim shehi shesa yom urevia yom shehu shesh shaot. veyesh mehen sheomrim shehu pachot mervia hayyom. vechen chachme yavan ufaras yesh benehen machaloket bedavar ze: 
Mi shehu omer shehi shesa yom urevia yom. yishshaer mikkol machazor shel tesha esre shana shaa achat vetf chalakim kemo sheamarnu. veyihye ben tekufa litkufa echad vetishim yom vesheva shaot vachatzi shaa. umishshetteda tekufa achat bee ze yom beezo shaa hi tatchil limnot mimmenna lattekufa hashsheniyya sheachareha umin hashsheniyya lashshelishit ad sof haolam:

Ketzad. hare sheratzinu leda tekufat nisan shel shenat tesha meot sheloshim vearbaat alafim laytzira. keshettashlich hakkol 28 28 tishshaer shana achat. tikkach lah yom echad veshesh shaot vetosif alav 3 nimtzet tekufat nisan belel chamishi shesh shaot ballayla. ucheshettosif aleha sheva shaot umechetza hare tihye tekufat tammuz beshaa umechetza miyyom Adonai. ucheshettosif aleha sheva shaot umechetza tihye tekufat tishre bet shaot miyyom Adonai. ucheshettosif aleha sheva shaot umechetza tihye tekufat tevet bed shaot umechetza millel 7. ucheshettosif aleha sheva shaot umechetza tihye tekufat nisan habbaa bitchillat yom 6. veal derech zo ad sof haolam tekufa achar tekufa: 
Im tirtze leda bechamma yom bachodesh tihye tekufat nisan shel shana zo. teda techilla bee ze yom mime hashshavua tihye uvee ze yom yikbeu nisan shel shana zo vechamma shanim gemurot avru min hammachazor. vetikkach lechol shana achad asar yom vetosif al sikkum hayyamim 7 yamim bizmannim ellu. vehashelech hakkol 30 30 vehannishar pachot mil tatchil limnoto merosh chodesh nisan. im yaggia leyom hattekufa mutav veim lav hosef yom o shene yamim o shelosha yamim al hamminyan ad sheyyaggia leyom hattekufa. veim tihye hashshana meebberet tatchil limnot merosh chodesh adar sheni velayyom sheyyaggia hacheshbon beoto hayyom min hachodesh tihye hattekufa: 
Ketzad. hare sheratzinu leda bechamma bachodesh tihye tekufat nisan shel shenat 930. shehi shana teshiit mimmachazor 260. matzanu rosh chodesh nisan nikba bah bachamishi utekufat nisan bachamishi. ulefi shehayta shana zo teshiit lammachazor yihyu hashshanim haggemurot shemone. keshettikkach lechol shana mehen 11 yom yihyu kol hayyamim 88. tosif 7 hare hakkol 95. tashlich hakkol 30 30 nisharu Adonai yamim. keshettatchil limnot Adonai yamim merosh chodesh nisan shehaya bachamishi yaggia hacheshbon leyom sheni. uchevar yadanu sheen hattekufa besheni beshabbat ella bachamishi. lefichach tosif yom achar yom ad shettaggia lachamishi shehu yom hattekufa. nimtzet tekufat nisan beshana zo beyom shemini mechodesh nisan. veal hadderech hazzot taase bechol shana veshana: 
Ze sheamarnu tosif yom achar yom ad shettaggia leyom hattekufa. leolam lo tihye tzarich lehosif ella yom echad o 2 o 3. ufele gadol hu shettihye tzarich lehosif arbaa yamim. veim matzata sheatta tzarich lehosif al ze teda shettaita bacheshbon vetachazor vetachshov bedikduk:

Shennat hachamma lemi shehu omer shehi pachot mervia mechachme yisrael. yesh mi sheomer 365 yom vechamesh shaot vettktzz chalakim umch rega. veharega echad mev bechelek. ulefi cheshbon ze tihye tosefet shenat hachamma al shenat hallevana 10 yamim vech shaa vekch chelek umch rega. siman lahen 31 121 48. velo timtza tosefet bemachazor shel 19 shana kelal ella bechol machazor mehem yishlemu shene hachamma im shene hallevana happeshutot vehameebbarot: 
Ben kol tekufa utekufa lefi cheshbon ze 91 yom vez shaot vetkyt chalakim vel rega. siman lahem 91 500 19 31. ucheshetteda tekufa min hattekufot ematay hayta. tachshov meoto rega minyan ze veteda tekufa sheachareha al hadderech shebbearnu bitkufat hashshana shehi revia:

mimmazzal akrav ad 20 mimmennu tikkach min harochav hashsheni reviito. veim yihye hayyareach mich maalot mimmazzal shor ad sofo o mich mimmazzal akrav ad sofo tikkach min harochav hashsheni chamishito. veim yihye hayyareach mittechillat mazzal teomim ad eser maalot mimmennu o mittechillat mazzal keshet ad eser maalot mimmennu tikkach min harochav hashsheni shetuto. veim yihye hayyareach mi maalot mimmazzal teomim vead 20 mimmennu o meeser mimmazzal keshet ad 20 mimmennu tikkach min harochav hashsheni chatzi shetuto. veim yihye mekom hayyareach mich mimmazzal teomim ad 25 mimmennu o mich mimmazzal keshet ad 25 mimmennu tikkach min harochav hashsheni revia shetuto. veim yihye mekom hayyareach mich mimmazzal teomim ad chamesh maalot mimmazzal sartan o mich mimmazzal keshet ad chamesh maalot mimmazzal gedi lo tikkach kelum. lefi sheen kan nelizat magal. veim yihye hayyareach mechamesh mimmazzal sartan ad eser mimmennu o mechamesh mimmazzal gedi ad eser mimmennu tikkach min harochav hashsheni revia shetuto. veim yihye mekom hayyareach mi mimmazzal sartan ad 20 mimmennu o meeser mimmazzal gedi ad esrim mimmennu tikkach min harochav hashsheni chatzi shetuto. veim yihye mekom hayyareach mich mimmazzal sartan ad sofo o mich mimmazzal gedi ad sofo tikkach min harochav hashsheni shetuto. veim yihye hayyareach mittechillat mazzal arye ad eser maalot mimmennu o mittechillat mazzal deli ad eser maalot mimmennu tikkach mimmennu harochav hashsheni chamishito. veim yihye hayyareach mi maalot mimmazzal arye ad 20 mimmennu o mi mimmazzal deli ad 20 mimmennu tikkach min harochav hashsheni reviito. veim yihye hayyareach mich mimmazzal arye ad eser mimmazzal betula o mich mimmazzal deli ad eser mimmazzal dagim tikkach min harochav hashsheni shelishito. veim yihye hayyareach meeser mimmazzal betula ad sofo o mi maalot mimmazzal dagim ad sofo tikkach min harochav hashsheni 2 chamishshav. vezot hammiktzat shettikkach min harochav hashsheni hi hannikret magal hayyareach:

Veachar kach tachazor vetitbonen berochav hayyareach vetire im hu tzefoni o deromi. im haya tzefoni tigra magal hayyareach hazze min haorech hashsheni. veim haya rochav hayyareach deromi tosif hammagal hazze al haorech hashsheni. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya mekom hayyareach mittechillat mazzal gedi ad sof mazzal teomim. aval im haya hayyareach mittechillat mazzal sartan ad sof mazzal keshet yihye haddavar hefech. sheim yihye rochav hayyareach tzefoni tosif hammagal al haorech hashsheni. veim haya rochav hayyareach deromi tigra hammagal min haorech hashsheni. uma sheyyihye haorech hashsheni achar shettosif alav o tigra mimmennu hu hannikra orech hashshelishi. veda sheim lo yihye sham nelizat magal velo natan hacheshbon lakachat min harochav hashsheni kelum. yihye haorech hashsheni atzmo hu haorech hashshelishi belo pachot uvelo yeter:

Veachar kach tachazor vetire haorech hashshelishi hazze vehu hammaalot shebben hayyareach vehashshemesh beeze mazzal hu. im yihye bemazzal dagim o bemazzal tale. tosif al haorech hashshelishi shetuto. veim yihye haorech bemazzal deli o bemazzal shor. tosif al haorech hashshelishi chamishito. veim yihye haorech bemazzal gedi o bemazzal teomim. tosif al haorech hashshelishi shetuto. veim yihye haorech bemazzal keshet o bemazzal sartan. taniach haorech hashshelishi kemot shehu velo tosif alav velo tigra mimmennu. veim haya haorech bemazzal akrav o bemazzal arye. tigra min haorech hashshelishi chamishito. veim yihye haorech bemazzal moznayim o bemazzal betula. tigra min haorech hashshelishi shelishito. uma sheyyihye haorech hashshelishi achar shettosif alav o tigra mimmennu o taniach oto kemot shehu. hu hannikra orech revii. veachar kach tachazor etzel rochav hayyareach harishon vetikkach shene shelishav leolam. veze hu hannikra menat gova hammedina. vetitbonen vetire im yihye rochav hayyareach tzefoni. tosif menat gova hammedina al haorech harvii. veim yihye rochav hayyareach deromi. tigra menat gova hammedina min haorech harvii. uma sheyyihye haorech harvii achar sheggorin mimmennu o shemmosifin alav hu hannikra keshet hariyya:

Ketzad. hare shebbanu lachkor im yerae hayyareach belel erev shabbat sheni lechodesh iyyar mishshana zo o lo yerae. totzi mekom hashshemesh haamitti umekom hayyareach haamitti verochav hayyareach leshana zo kemo shehodanucha. yetze lecha mekom hashshemesh haamitti bez maalot vet chalakim mimmazzal shor. simano 16. veyetze lecha mekom hayyareach haamitti beych maalot velv chalakim mimmazzal shor. simano 18 36. veyetze lecha rochav hayyareach beruach darom shalosh maalot veng chalakim. simano 53 3. veze hu harochav harishon. vetigra mekom hashshemesh mimmekom hayyareach yishshaer 11 maalot vechz chalakim. simano 11 27. veze hu haorech harishon. ulefi shehaya hayyareach bemazzal shor yihye shinnuy mare haorech maala achat verauy ligroa otah min haorech harishon. yetze lecha haorech hashsheni 10 maalot vechz chalakim. simano 37. vechen yihye shinnuy mare harochav 10 chalakim. ulefi sherochav hayyareach haya deromi rauy lehosif alav shinnuy hammare shehu asara chalakim. yetze lecha harochav hashsheni 4 maalot veg chalakim. simano 7. ulefi shehaya hayyareach beych maalot mimmazzal shor rauy likkach min harochav hashsheni reviito vehu hannikra magal hayyareach. yetze lecha magal hayyareach leet zo maala achat vechelek echad lefi sheen medakdekin bishniyyot:

Ulefi sherochav hayyareach deromi umekom hayyareach haamitti ben rosh gedi verosh sartan. rauy lehosif hammagal al haorech hashsheni. yetze lecha haorech hashshelishi 11 maalot vechch chalakim. simano 11 28. ulefi shehaorech hazze bemazzal shor rauy lehosif al haorech hashshelishi chamishito shehu shete maalot veych chalakim. veyetze lecha haorech harvii 13 maalot umv chalakim. simano 13 46. vechazarnu etzel harochav harishon velakachnu shene shelishav veyetze menat gova hammedina vehu shete maalot vel chalakim. ulefi shehaya harochav deromi. rauy ligroa mimmennu menat gova hammedina min haorech harvii. yishshaer lecha 11 maalot vey chalakim. simano 11 11. vezo hi keshet hariyya ballayla hazze. veal hadderech hazze taase veteda keshet hariyya kamma maalot vechamma chalakim yesh bah bechol lel reiyya shettirtze leolam:

Veachar shettetze keshet zo tavin bah. veda sheim tihye keshet hariyya tesha maalot o pachot az efshar sheyyerae bechol eretz yisrael. veim tihye keshet hariyya yeter al 14 maalot i efshar shello yerae veyihye galuy lechol eretz yisrael:

Veim tihye keshet hariyya mittechillat maala asirit ad sof maalat 14. taaroch keshet hariyya el haorech harishon veteda im yerae o lo yerae min hakkitztzin sheyyesh lo. vehen hannikrain kitztze hariyya:

Veillu hen kitztze hariyya. im tihye keshet hariyya miyyeter al 9 maalot ad sof eser maalot o yeter al eser. veyihye haorech harishon 13 maalot o yoter. vadday yerae. veim tihye hakkeshet pachot mizze o yihye haorech pachot mizze lo yerae:

Veim tihye keshet hariyya miyyeter al eser maalot ad sof 11 maalot o yeter al achat esre. veyihye haorech harishon 12 maalot o yoter. vadday yerae. veim tihye hakkeshet pachot mizze o yihye haorech pachot mizze lo yerae:

Veim tihye keshet hariyya miyyeter al 11 ad sof 12 maalot o yeter al 12. veyihye haorech harishon 11 maalot o yoter vadday yerae. veim tihye hakkeshet pachot mizze o yihye haorech pachot mizze lo yerae:

Veim tihye keshet hariyya miyyeter al 12 maalot ad sof 13 maalot o yeter al 13. veyihye haorech harishon 10 maalot o yoter vadday yerae. veim tihye hakkeshet pachot mizze o yihye haorech pachot mizze lo yerae:

Veim tihye hariyya miyyeter al 13 maalot ad sof 14 maalot o yeter al 14. veyihye haorech harishon tesha maalot o yoter vadday yerae. veim tihye hakkeshet pachot mizze o yihye haorech pachot mizze lo yerae. vead kan sof hakkitztzin:

Ketzad. banu lehitbonen bekeshet hariyya shel lel erev shabbat sheni lechodesh iyyar mishshana zo. yetze lanu becheshbon keshet hariyya 11 maalot vey chalakim kemo sheyyadata. ulefi shehaya keshet hariyya ben eser ad arba esre arachnu otah el haorech harishon. uchevar yadata shehaorech haya belel ze 11 maalot vechz chalakim. ulefi shehayta keshet hariyya yeter al 11 maalot vehaya haorech harishon yeter al asara [1.] yodea shevvadday yerae belel ze lefi hakkitztzin hakketzuvot. vechen taase bechol keshet vakeshet im haorech harishon shellah:

Uchevar raita min hammaasim haellu kamma cheshbonot yesh bo vechamma tosafot vechamma geruin achar sheyyaganu harebe. ad shehimtzianu derachim kerovim sheen becheshbonam omek gadol. shehayyareach akalkallot gedolot yesh bemagelotav. ulefichach amru chachamim <small>(Tehillim 104 19)</small> "shemesh yada mevoo" yareach lo yada mevoo. veamru chachamim peamim ba baarukka peamim ba biktzara. kemo shettire mecheshbonot ellu sheppeamim tosif ufeamim tigra ad shettehe keshet hariyya. ufeamim tihye keshet hariyya arukka ufeamim ketzara kemo shebbearnu:

Vetaam kol ellu hacheshbonot umippene ma mosifim minyan ze umippene ma gorin. veheach noda kol davar vedavar meellu haddevarim. veharaya al kol davar vedavar. hi chachmat hattekufot vehaggimatriyyot shechibberu bah chachme yavan sefarim harebe vehem hannimtzaim achshav beyad hachachamim. aval hassefarim shechibberu chachme yisrael shehayu bime hanneviim mibbene yissashchar lo higgiu elenu. umeachar shekkol ellu haddevarim birayot berurot hem sheen bahem dofi vei efshar leadam lehareher acharehem, en choshshin lamchabber ben shechibberu otam neviim ben shechibberu otam haummot. shekkol davar shennitgalla taamo venoda amittato birayot sheen bahem dofi anu somchin al ze haish sheamaro o shellimmedo al haraya shennitgalleta vehattaam shennoda:

Davar yadua uvarur sheim yotzi lecha hacheshbon shehayyareach yerae ballayila. efshar sheyyerae veefshar shello yerae mippene heavim shemmechassin oto o mippene hammakom shehu gay o sheyyihye har gavoah keneged ruach maarav leanshe oto hammakom shennimtzeu keillu hen yoshvin baggay. shehayyareach lo yerae lemi shehu bemakom namuch afillu haya gadol veyerae lemi shehu omed berosh har gavoah vetalul af al pi shehayyareach katan beyoter. vechen yerae lemi sheshshochen al sefat hayyam o lemi shemmehallech bisfina bayyam haggadol af al pi shehu katan beyoter: 
Vechen bimot haggeshamim im yihye yom tzach yerae hayyareach yoter mimma sheyyerae bimot hachamma. lefi shebbimot haggeshamim im yihye yom tzach yihye haavir zach harebe veyerae harakia betohar yoter mippene sheen sham avak sheyyitarev baavir. aval bimot hachamma yihye haavir keillu hu meeshshan mippene haavak veyerae hayyareach katan: 
Vechol zeman shettimmatze keshet hariyya vehaorech harishon shettaaroch lah im shene hakkitztzin shellahem betzimtzum. yihye hayyareach katan beyoter velo yerae ella bemakom gavoah beyoter. veim timmatze keshet hariyya vehaorech harishon arukkin harebe vehosifu ad sof hakkitztzim shellahen mimmaalot. yerae hayyareach gadol ulefi orech hakkeshet vehaorech harishon yihye gadlo ugeliyyato lakkol: 
Lefichach rauy levet din lasum shene devarim ellu belibbam. shehen zeman hariyya umekomah. veshoalin et haedim bee ze makom reitem. sheim hayta keshet hariyya ketzara veyitten hacheshbon sheyyerae betzimtzum. kegon shehayta keshet hariyya 9 maalot vaAdonai chalakim vehaya haorech harishon 13 maalot beshave uvau edim sherauhu. im haya bimot hachamma o shehayu bemakom namuch choshshin lahen uvodkin otan harebe veim haya bimot haggeshamim o bemakom gavoah beyoter vadday yerae im lo yihyu sham avim hammavdilin: 
Edim sherau et hachodesh bizmanno uvau veheidu vekibbelum bet din vekiddeshu et hachodesh hazze harishon umanu 29 yom min hayyom ham [ke] dash. velel sheloshim lo nira hayyareach mippene shei efshar lo leheraot o mippene shekkissuhu avim. vahare bet din metzappin lo kol yom sheloshim kemo shebbearnu. velo bau edim veibberu et hachodesh venimtza yom Rosh Chodesh hashsheni yom 31 kemo shebbearnu: 
Vehitchilu limnot 29 yom min yom rosh hachodesh hashsheni velel sheloshim lo nira hayyareach. im tomar shekkach meabberin et ze veosin oto sheloshim vekovin rosh hachodesh hashshelishi yom 31. kach efshar shello yerae hayyareach belel sheloshim gam mechodesh ze venimtzeu meabberin veholchin veosin chodashim achar sheloshim kol hashshana kullah. venimtza bechodesh acharon efshar sheyyerae hayyareach belel 25 bo o belel 26. veen lecha devar sechok vehefsed yoter mizze: 
Veal tomar shehaddavar hazze davar sheeno matzuy hu shello yerae hayyareach bechol hashshana. ella davar karov hu harebe. ufeamim rabbot yeera ze vechayyotze bo bammedinot shezzeman haggeshamim sham aroch veheavim rabbim. sheen anu omrin shello yerae hayyareach bechol hashshana ella shello yerae bitchillat hechodashim veyerae achar kach. ufeamim lo yerae mippene shei efshar lo sheyyerae bahem vechodashim sheefshar sheyyerae bahem lo yerae mippene heavim o mippene shehaya katan beyoter velo nitkavven adam liroto: 
Ella hakkabbala shehaya beyad chachamim ish mippi ish mippi moshe rabbenu kach hi. shebbizman shello yerae hayyareach bitchillat hechodashim chodesh achar chodesh. bet din kovin chodesh meebbar mishsheloshim yom vechodesh chaser micht yom. vechen mechashshevin vekovin chodesh meubbar vechodesh chaser bikvia lo bekiddush. sheen mekaddeshin ella al hariyya. ufeamim osin male achar male o chaser achar chaser kemo sheyyerae lahem min hacheshbon: 
Umitkavvenin leolam becheshbonam sheim yerae hayyareach bachodesh habba yerae bizmanno o belel ibburo. lo sheyyerae kodem zemanno shehu lel 28. uvecheshbonot hariyya haellu shebbearnu yitbaer lecha veteda matay efshar sheyyerae, umatay i efshar, shello yerae. veal ze somchin umeabberin chodesh achar chodesh o osin chodesh chaser achar chodesh chaser. uleolam en pochatin mearbaa chodashim hameubbarin beshana velo mosifin al shemona chodashim hameubbarin. vegam leibbur chodashim ellu shemmeabberin lefi cheshbon osin seuddat ibbur hachodesh kemo sheamarnu beferek shelishi: 
Vechol shettimtza baggemara middevariyim shemmarin shebbet din somchin al hacheshbon umippi moshe missinay shehaddavar masur lahem veharshut beyadam lechasser o leabber. vechen ze shechaser tisha chodashim bashshana vechol kayyotze baze hakkol al ikkar ze hu banuy bizman shello nire hachodesh bizmanno: 
Vechen ze sheamru chachamim shemmeabberin et hachodesh letzorech hu bechodashim ellu shemmeabberin otan lefi cheshbon veosin echad male veechad chaser. veyesh lahem leabber chodesh achar chodesh o lechasser. baze hu shemmeabberin letzorech mippene shello nire hayyareach bizmanno. ella beet sheyyerae hayyareach bizmanno shehu techillat heyoto nire achar shennitkabbetz im hashshemesh mekaddeshin leolam: 
Vechol haddevarim haellu bizman sheyyesh sham bet din vesomchin al hariyya. aval bizmannim ellu en somchin ella al hakkevia beze hacheshbon haemtzai happashut bechol yisrael kemo shebbearnu bahalachot ellu: 
Yitbaer besifre hacheshbon hattekufot vehaggimatriyyaot sheim yerae hayyareach beeretz yisrael yerae bechol medinot haolam shehen lemaarav eretz yisrael umechuvvanot kenegdah. veim yitten hacheshbon shello yerae beeretz yisrael efshar sheyyerae bimdinot acherot shehen lemaarav eretz yisrael umechuvvanot kenegdah. lefichach im yerae hayyareach bimdina shehi lemaarav eretz yisrael en baze reaya shello yerae beeretz yisrael ella efshar shennire hayyareach beeretz yisrael: 
Aval im lo yerae hayyareach berosh heharim bammedina hammaaravit hamechuvvenet keneged eretz yisrael beyadua shello nire beeretz yisrael: 
Vechen im lo yerae hayyareach beeretz yisrael beyadua shello nire bechol medinot haolam shehen lemizrach eretz yisrael umechuvvanot kenegdah. veim yerae beeretz yisrael efshar sheyyerae bimdinot mizrachiyyot veefshar shello yerae. lefichach im yerae bimdina shehi lemizrach eretz yisrael umechuvvenet kenegdah beyadua shennire beeretz yisrael. veim lo nire bammedina hammizrachit en baze reaya ella efshar sheyyerae beeretz yisrael: 
Vechol ellu haddevarim keshehayu hammedinot shebbammaarav veshebbammizrach mechuvvanot. kegon shehayu notot litzfon haolam mishsheloshim maalot ad 35 maalot. aval im hayu notot latztzafon yoter mizze o pachot. mishpatim acherim yesh lahen shehare enan mechuvvanot keneged eretz yisrael. udevarim ellu shebbearnu beare mizrach umaarav enan ella lehaggid kol mishpete hariyya lehagedil tora ulehadirah. lo sheyyihyu bene mizrach o bene maarav somchin al reiyyat hayyareach o toil lahem kelum. ella leolam en somchin ella al kiddush bet din shebbeeretz yisrael kemo shebbearnu kamma peamim:

Lefi sheamru chachamim shebbochlal divarim shehayu bodkin bahen et haedim omrin lahen lehechan haya hayyareach note. kasher beenay lehodia derech cheshbon davar ze. veen ani medakdek bo lefi sheeno moil biriyya kelal. utechillat cheshbon ze leda netiyyat hammazzalot techilla: 
Haagulla shehi overet bemachatzit hammazzalot shebbah mahalach hashshemesh. enah overet beemtza haolam mechatzi hammizrach lachatzi hammaarav. ella nota hi meal hakkav hashshave hamesabbev beemtza haolam keneged tzafon vedarom. chetzyah note latztzafon vechetzyah note laddarom: 
Ushete nekuddot yesh bah sheppogaat bahen baagullat hakkav hashshave hamesabbev beemtza haolam. hannekudda haachat rosh mazzal tale. hannekudda hashsheniyya shekkenegdah rosh mazzal moznayim. venimtzeu shishsha mazzalot notot latztzafon mittechillat tale ad sof betula. veshishsha notot laddarom mittechillat mazzal moznayim ad sof mazzal dagim: 
Umerosh mazzal tale yatchilu hammazzalot lintot meat meat ulehitrachek meal hakkav hashshave keneged hatztzafon ad rosh sartan. veyihye rosh sartan rachok meal hakkav hashshave leruach hatztzafon shalosh veesrim maalot vachatzi maala bekeruv. veyachzeru hammazzalot lehitkarev lakkav hashshave meat meat ad rosh moznayim shehu al hakkav hashshave. umerosh moznayim yatchilu lintot ulehitrachek keneged ruach darom ad rosh gedi. veyihye rosh gedi rachok meal hakkav hashshave leruach darom shalosh veesrim maalot vachatzi maala. veyachzeru hammazzalot lehitkarev meat meat keneged hakkav hashshave ad rosh tale: 
Nimtza rosh tale verosh moznayim mesabbev al hakkav hashshave. ulefichach keshettihye hashshemesh bishne rashim ellu lo tihye nota lo latztzafon velo laddarom. vetizrach bachatzi mizrach vetishka bachatzi maarav. veyihye hayyom vehallayla shavin bechol hayyishshuv: 
Hare nitbarer lecha shekkol maala umaala mimmaalot hammazzalot nota latztzafon o laddarom veyesh lintiyyatah shiur. (verov) [verochav] hannetiyya lo tihye yoter al shalosh veesrim maalot vachatzi bekeruv: 
Veellu hem hashshiurim shel netiyyot lefi minyan hammaalot shel mazzalot. vehatechala matchelet mazzal tale. 10 maalot netiyyatam 4 maalot. 20 maalot netiyyatam 8 maalot. 30 maalot netiyyatam 11 maalot umechetza. um maalot netiyyatam 15 maalot. 50 maalot netiyyatam 18 maalot. 60 maalot netiyyatam 20 maalot. 70 maalot netiyyatam 22 maalot. 80 maalot netiyyatam 23 maalot. 90 maalot netiyyatam 23 maalot vachatzi maala: 
Veim yihyu achadim beminyan tikkach lahem menatam mibben shete hannetiyyot kemo shebbearnu bashshemesh uvayyareach. ketzad. chamesh maalot netiyyatam shete maalot. veim haya minyan hammaalot 23 netiyyatam 9 maalot. veal derech zo bechol haachadim shehen im haasarot: 
Umeachar shetteda hannetiyya shel maalot meachat ad 90. teda netiyyatam kullan kederech shehodanucha berochav hayyareach. sheim haya hamminyan yeter al 90 ad 180 tigra oto mikf. veim haya yoter al 180 ad 270 tigra mimmennu 180. veim haya yoter al 270 ad 360 tigra oto mishs. vehannishar teda netiyyato vehu netiyyat oto hamminyan shebbeyadcha belo geraon velo tosefet: 
Im tirtze leda kamma maalot hu hayyareach note meal hakkav hashshave keneged tzefon haolam o keneged derom haolam. teda techilla kamma netiyyat hammaala shehi mekom hayyareach haamitti ulee ze ruach hi nota latztzafon o laddarom. vetachazor vetachshov vetotzi rochav hayyareach harishon vetire im hu tzefoni o deromi. im nimtzeu rochav hayyareach unetiyyat maalato beruach achat kegon shehayu shenehem tzefonim o deromiyyim tekabbetz shenehem. veim nimtzeu bishte ruchot kegon shehaya haechad deromi vehaechad tzefoni. tigra hammeat mishshenehem min harav vehannishar hu merchak hayyareach meal hakkav hashshave beotah haruach shehaya bah harav bishnehem: 
Ketzad banu leda kamma hayyareach note meal hakkav hashshave belel hariyya shehu sheni lechodesh iyyar mishshana zo. uchevar yadata shemmaalat hayyareach hayta 19 mimmazzal shor. netiyyatah batztzafon kemo 18 maalot. verochav hayyareach haya baddarom kemo 4 maalot. tigra hammeat min harav yishshaer 14 maalot. venimtza hayyareach rachok meal hakkav hashshave 14 maalot leruach tzafon. shehare hamminyan harav shehu shemone esre maalot haya tzefoni. vechol cheshbon ze bekeruv belo dikduk lefi sheeno moil biriyya: 
Im tirtze leda lee zo ruach meruchot haolam yerae hayyareach note. tachshov veteda merchakko meal hakkav hashshave. im yihye al hakkav hashshave o karov mimmennu bishtayim o shalosh maalot batztzafon o baddarom. yerae mechuvvan keneged emtza maarav veterae pegimato mechuvvenet keneged mizrach haolam beshave: 
Veim yihye rachok meal hakkav hashshave litzfon haolam. yerae ben maarav haolam uven tzefono. veterae pegimato nota mikkeneged mizrach haolam keneged derom haolam: 
Veim haya rachok meal hakkav hashshave lidrom haolam. yerae ben maarav haolam uven deromo. veterae pegimato nota mikkeneged mizrach haolam keneged tzefon haolam. ulefi rov hammerchak ulefi rov hannetiyya: 
Umechakirat haedim sheomrin lahem kamma haya gavoah. vedavar ze yivvada mikkeshet hariyya. shebbizman shettihye keshet hariyya ketzara yerae hayyareach keillu hu karov min haaretz. uvizman shettihye arukka yerae gavoah meal haaretz. ulefi orech keshet hariyya lefi gavho meal haaretz biriyyat haenayim: 
Hare bearnu cheshbonot kol hadderachim shetztzerichin lahem bidiat hariyya uvachakirat haedim. kede sheyyihye hakkol yadua lammevinim velo yechseru derech middarche hattora velo yeshottu levakkesh achareha bisfarim acherim. <small>(yeshaya lod 16)</small> "dirshu meal sefer Adonai" vekiru, achat mehenna lo nedara: salik hilchot kiddush hachodesh
Mishneh Torah, Scroll of Esther and Hanu:
Keriat hammegilla bizmannah mitzvat ase middivre sofrim. vehaddevarim yeduim shehi takkanat hanneviim. vehakkol chayyavim bikriatah anashim venashim vegerim vaavadim meshuchrarim. umechannechin et hakketannim likrotah. vaafillu kohanim baavodatan mevattelin avodatan uvain lishmoa mikra megilla. vechen mevattelim talmud tora lishmoa mikra megilla kal vachomer lishar mitzvot shel tora shekkullan nidchin mippene mikra megilla. veen lecha davar shennidche mikra megilla mippanav chutz mimmet mitzva sheen lo kovrin shehappogea bo kovro techilla veachar kach kore: 
Echad hakkore veechad hashshomea min hakkore yatza yede chovato vehu sheyyishma mippi mi shehu chayyav bikriatah. lefichach im haya hakkore katan o shote hashshomea mimmennu lo yatza: 
Mitzva likrot et kullah. umitzva likrotah ballayla uvayyom. vechol hallayla kasher likriat hallayla. vechol hayyom kasher likriat hayyom. umevarech kodem keriatah ballayla shalosh berachot veellu hen. baruch atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al mikra megilla. baruch atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam sheasa nissim laavotenu bayyamim hahem uvazzeman hazze. baruch atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam shehecheyanu vekiyyemanu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze. uvayyom eno chozer umevarech shehecheyanu. umakom shennahagu levarech achareha mevarech baruch atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam hael harav et rivenu vehaddan et dinenu vehannokem et nikmatenu vehannifra lanu mitztzarenu vehameshallem gemul lechol oyve nafshenu baruch atta Adonai hannifra leyisrael mikkol tzarehem hael hammoshia: 
Ezehu zeman keriatah. zemannim harebe tikkenu lah chachamim shenneemar <small>(Ester 9 lo)</small> "bizmannehem". veellu hen zemanne keriatah. kol medina shehayta mukkefet choma mime yehoshua bin nun ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz af al pi sheen lah achshav choma korin betv baadar. umedina zo hi hannikret kerach. vechol medina shello hayta mukkefet choma bimot yehoshua veaf al pi shehi mukkefet atta korin beyd. umedina zo hi hannikret ir: 
Shushan habbira af al pi shello hayta mukkefet choma bime yehoshua bin nun korin betv shebbah haya hannes shenneemar <small>(Ester 9 18)</small> "venoach bachamishsha asar bo". velamma talu haddavar bime yehoshua kede lachalok kavod leeretz yisrael shehayta chareva beoto hazzeman. kede sheyyihyu korin kivne shushan veyechashvu keillu hen kerakkin hammukkafin choma af al pi shehen atta charevin hoil vehayu mukkafin bime yehoshua korin betv veyihye zikkaron leeretz yisrael benes ze: 
Bene hakkefarim sheenam mitkabbetzim bevatte kenesiyyot ella besheni uvachamishi tikkenu lahem sheyyihyu makdimin vekorim beyom hakkenisa. ketzad. im chal yom 14 lihyot besheni o bachamishi korin bo bayyom. veim chal beyom acher chutz mishsheni vachamishi makdimin vekorin besheni o bachamishi hassamuch leyd: 
Ketzad. chal 14 lihyot beechad beshabbat makdimin vekorin bachamishi shehu yom 11. chal lihyot bishlishi korin besheni shehu yom 13. chal lihyot birvii korin besheni shehu yom 12. vechol ellu shemmakdimin vekorin kodem 14 en korin otah befachot measara: 
Kefar shemmakdimin vekorin beyom hakkenisa bizman sheen nichnasin bo besheni uvachamishi en korin otah ella beyd. vechol ir sheen bah asara batlanin kevuin bevet hakkeneset letzarche hatztzibbur hare hi kichfar umakdimin vekorin beyom hakkenisa. veim en sham asara bene adam takkanato kalkalato vahare hem keanshe ir gedola veen korin ella beyd: 
Bamme devarim amurim shemmakdimin vekorin beyom hakkenisa bizman sheyyesh lahem leyisrael malchut. aval bazzeman hazze en korin otah ella bizmannah shehu yom 14 veyom 15. bene hakkefarim uvene ayarot korin beyd. uvene kerakkin korin betv: 
Ben ir shehalach lakkerach o ben kerach shehalach lair im haya dato lachazor limkomo bizman keria venitakkev velo chazar kore kimkomo. veim lo haya bedato lachazor ella leachar zeman hakkeria kore im anshe hammakom shehu sham. ucherach vechol hassamuch lo vechol hannire immo im en benehem yeter al alpayim amma hare ze kichrach vekorin bachamishsha asar: 
Ir shehi safek veen yadua im hayta mukkefet choma bimot yehoshua bin nun o achar ken hukkefa korin bishne hayyamim shehen 14 vetv uvelelehem. umevarchin al keriatah beyd bilvad hoil vehu zeman keriatah lerov haolam: 
Karu et hammegilla baadar rishon veachar kach ibberu bet din et hashshana chozrim vekorim otah baadar hashsheni bizmannah: 
En korin et hammegilla beshabbat gezera shemma yittol otah beyado veyelech etzel mi shehu baki likrotah veyaavirenna arba ammot birshut harabbim. shehakkol chayyavim bikriatah veen hakkol bekiin bikriatah. lefichach im chal zeman keriatah beshabbat makdimin vekorin otah kodem hashshabbat. veshoalin vedorshin behilchot purim beotah shabbat kede lehazekir shehu purim: 
Ketzad. yom arbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat bene ayarot makdimin vekorin beerev shabbat uvene kerakkim korim bizmannam beechad beshabbat. chal yom 15 lihyot beshabbat bene kerakkim makdimin vekorin beerev shabbat shehu yom arbaa asar uvene ayarot korin bo bayyom shehu zemannam venimtzeu hakkol korin bearbaa asar:

Hakore et hammegilla lemafrea lo yatza. kara veshachach pasuk echad vekara pasuk sheni lo vechazar vekara pasuk sheshshachach vechazar vekara pasuk shelishi lo yatza mippene shekkara pasuk echad lemafrea. ella ketzad ose. matchil mippasuk sheni sheshshachach vekore al hasseder:

Matza tzibbur shekkaru chetzyah lo yomar ekra chetzyah haacharon im hatztzibbur veechezor veekra chetzyah rishon, shezze kore lemafrea. ella kore mittechilla vead sof al hasseder. kara veshaha meat vechazar vekara af al pi sheshshaha kede ligmor et kullah hoil vekara al hasseder yatza:

Hakkore et hammegilla al pe lo yatza yede chovato. halloez sheshshama et hammegilla hakketuva bilshon hakkodesh uvichtav hakkodesh af al pi sheeno yodea ma hen omrin yatza yede chovato. vechen im hayta ketuva yevanit ushemaah yatza af al pi sheeno makkir, vaafillu haya hashshomea ivri:

Hayta ketuva targum o belashon acheret milleshonot haggoyim lo yatza yede chovato bikriatah ella hammakkir otah hallashon bilvad. vehu shettihye ketuva bichtav oto hallashon. aval im hayta ketuva bichtav ivri ukeraah aramit laarami lo yatza shennimtza ze kore al pe. vechevan shello yatza yede chovato hakkore lo yatza hashshomea mimmennu:

Hakkore et hammegilla belo kavvana lo yatza. ketzad. haya kotvah o dorshah o maggihah im kivven et libbo latzet bikria zo yatza veim lo kivvin libbo lo yatza. kara vehu mitnamnem hoil velo nirdam bashshena yatza:

Bamme devarim amurim shehamechavven libbo bakketiva yatza. beshennitkavven latzet bakkeria shekkore besefer shemmatik mimmennu beshaa shehu kotev. aval im lo nitkavven latzet bikria zo shekkatav lo yatza. sheeno yotze yede chovato ella bikriatah missefer shekkullah ketuva bo bishat keria:

Hakkore et hammegilla vetaa bikriatah vekara keria meshubbeshet yatza. lefi sheen medakdekin bikriatah. keraah omed o yoshev yatza vaafillu betzibbur. aval lo yikra betzibbur yoshev lechattechilla mippene kevod hatztzibbur. kerauha shenayim afillu asara keechad yatzu hakkorin vehashshomim min hakkorin. vekore otah gadol im hakkatan vaafillu betzibbur:

En korin betzibbur bimgilla hakketuva ben hakketuvim. veim kara lo yatza. ella im ken hayta yetera al shear hayeriot o chasera kede sheyyehe lah hekker. aval hayyachid kore bah vaafillu enah chasera velo yetera veyotze bah yede chovato:

En kotvin hammegilla ella bidyo al haggevil o al hakkelaf kesefer tora. veim ketavah beme appetza vekankantom keshera. ketavah bishar mine tzivonin pesula. utzericha sirtut kattora atzmah. veen haor shellah tzarich leabbed lishmah. hayta ketuva al hanneyar o al or sheeno meubbad o shekketavah akkum o eppikoros pesula:

Hayu bah otiyyot metushtashot o mekoraot. im rishshuman nikkar afillu hayu rubbah keshera. veim en rishshuman nikkar im haya rubbah shalem keshera. veim lav pesula vehakkore bah lo yatza. hishmit bah hassofer otiyyot o pesukim ukeraan hakkore et hammegilla al pe yatza:

Hammegilla tzericha shettehe tefura kullah ad sheyyihyu kol oroteha megilla achat. veenah nitperet ella begidin kesefer tora. veim tefarah shello begidin pesula. veeno tzarich litpor et kol hayeria begidin kesefer tora ella afillu tafar begidin shalosh tefirot biktze hayeria veshalosh beemtzaah veshalosh bakkatze hashsheni keshera mippene shennikret iggeret:

Vetzarich hakkore likrot aseret bene haman vaaseret binshima achat kede lehodia lechol haam shekkullam nitlu venehergu keechad. uminhag kol yisrael shehakkore hammegilla kore ufoshet keiggeret lehareot hannes uchesheyyigmor chozer vechorchah kullah umevarech:

Shene hayyamim haellu shehen 14 vetv asurin behesped vetaanit lechol adam bechol makom. ben livne kerakkin shehen osin 15 bilvad. ben livne ayarot shehen osin 14 bilvad. ushene hayyamim asurin behesped vetaanit baadar harishon uvaadar hashsheni. anshe kefarim shehikdimu vekaru besheni o bachamishi hassamuch lefurim muttarim behesped vetaanit beyom keriatah vaasurin behesped vetaanit bishne hayyamim haellu af al pi sheen korin bahen:

Mitzvat yom 14 livne kefarim vaayarot veyom 15 livne kerakkim lihyot yom simcha umishte umishloach manot lereim umattanot laevyonim. umuttar baasiyyat melacha, veaf al pi chen en rauy laasot bo melacha. amru chachamim kol haose melacha beyom purim eno roe siman beracha leolam. bene kefarim shekkadmu vekaru besheni o bachamishi im chilleku maot laevyonim beyom keriatan yatzu. aval hassimcha vehammishte en osin otam ella beyom 14. veim hikdimu lo yatzu. useuddat purim sheasaah ballayla lo yatza yede chovato:

Ketzad chovat seudda zo. sheyyochal basar vitakken seudda naa kefi asher timtza yado. veshote yayin ad sheyyishtakker veyeradem beshichruto. vechen chayyav adam lishloach shete menot basar o shene mine tavshil o shene mine ochalin lachavero shenneemar <small>(Ester 9 19)</small> "umishloach manot ish lereehu", shete manot leish echad. vechol hammarbe lishloach lereim meshubbach. veim en lo machalif im chavero ze sholeach leze seuddato veze sholeach leze seuddato kede lekayyem umishloach manot ish lereehu:

Vechayyav lechallek laaniyyim beyom happurim. en pochatin mishshene aniyyim noten lechol echad mattana achat o maot o mine tavshil o mine ochalin shenneemar <small>(Ester 9 22)</small> "umattanot laevyonim", shete mattanot lishne aniyyim. veen medakdekin bimot purim ella kol happoshet yado littol notnin lo. veen meshannin maot purim litzdaka acheret:

Mutav laadam leharebot bemattenot evyonim milleharbot bisuddato uveshilluach manot lereav. sheen sham simcha gedola umefoara ella lesammeach lev aniyyim vitomim vealmanot vegerim. shehamesammeach lev haumlalim haellu dome lashshechina shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 57 15)</small> "lehachayot ruach shefalim ulehachayot lev nidkaim":

Kol sifre hanneviim vechol hakketuvim atidin libbatel limot hammashiach chutz mimmegillat ester vahare hi kayyemet kachamishsha chummeshe tora vechahalachot shel tora shebbeal pe sheenan betelin leolam. veaf al pi shekkol zichron hatztzarot yevuttal shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 65 16)</small> "ki nishkechu hatztzarot harishonot vechi nisteru meeni". yeme happurim lo yibbatlu shenneemar <small>(Ester 9 28)</small> "vime happurim haelle lo yaavru mittoch hayyehudim vezichram lo yasuf mizzaram":

Vevayit sheni keshemmalche yavan gazru gezerot al yisrael uvittelu datam velo henichu otam laasok betora uvemitzvot. ufashtu yadam bemamonam uvivnotehem venichnesu lahechol ufartzu bo peratzot vetimmeu hattohorot. vetzar lahem leyisrael meod mippenehem ulechatzum lachatz gadol ad sherichem alehem elohe avotenu vehoshiam miyyadam vehitztzilam vegavru bene chashmonay hakkohanim haggedolim vaharagum vehoshiu yisrael miyyadam veheemidu melech min hakkohanim vechazra malchut leyisrael yeter al matayim shana ad hachurban hashsheni: 
Uchesheggavru yisrael al oyvehem veibbedum bech bechodesh kislev haya venichnesu lahechol velo matzu shemen tahor bammikdash ella pach echad velo haya bo lehadelik ella yom echad bilvad vehidliku mimmennu nerot hammaaracha shemona yamim ad shekkatshu zetim vehotziu shemen tahor: 
Umippene ze hitkinu chachamim shebbeoto haddor sheyyihyu shemonat hayyamim haellu shettechillatan 25 bechislev yeme simcha vehallel umadlikin bahen hannerot baerev al pitche habbattim bechol layla velayla mishshemonat hallelot lehareot ulegallot hannes. veyamim ellu hen hannikrain chanukka vehen asurin behesped vetaanit kime happurim. vehadelakat hannerot bahen mitzva middivre sofrim kikriat hammegilla: 
Kol shechayyav bikriat hammegilla chayyav behadelakat ner chanukka vehammadlik otah ballayla harishon mevarech shalosh berachot veellu hen. baruch atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehadelik ner shel chanukka vesheasa nissim laavotenu vechulei. veshehecheyanu vekiyyemanu vechulei. vechol haroe otah velo berech mevarech shetayim. sheasa nissim laavotenu veshehecheyanu. uvishar hallelot hammadlik mevarech shetayim veharoe mevarech achat sheen mevarchin shehecheyanu ella ballayla harishon: 
Bechol yom vayom mishshemonat hayyamim ellu gomrin et hahallel umevarech lefanav asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu ligmor et hahallel ben yachid ben tzibbur. af al pi shekkeriat hahallel mitzva middivre sofrim mevarech alav asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu kederech shemmevarech al hammegilla veal haeruv. shekkol vadday shel divrehem mevarchin alav. aval davar shehu middivrehem veikkar asiyyatan lo mippene hassafek kegon maaser demay en mevarchin alav. velamma mevarchin al yom tov sheni vehem lo tikkenuhu ella mippene hassafek kede shello yezalzelu bo: 
Velo hallel shel chanukka bilvad hu shemmiddivre sofrim ella keriat hahallel leolam middivre sofrim bechol hayyamim sheggomrin bahen et hahallel. ushemona asar yom bashshana mitzva ligmor bahen et hahallel. veillu hen. shemonat yeme hechag. ushemonat yeme chanukka. verishon shel pesach veyom atzeret. aval rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim en bahen hallel lefi shehen yeme teshuva veyira vafachad lo yeme simcha yetera. velo tikkenu hallel befurim shekkeriat hammegilla hi hahallel: 
Mekomot sheosin yom tov shene yamim gomrin et hahallel esrim veechad yom. tisha yeme hechag. ushemona yeme chanukka. ushene yamim shel pesach. ushene yamim shel atzeret. aval berashe chodashim keriat hahallel minhag veeno mitzva. uminhag ze betzibbur lefichach korin bedillug. veen mevarchin alav sheen mevarchin al hamminhag. veyachid lo yikra kelal. veim hitchil yashlim veyikra bedillug kederech shekkorin hatztzibbur. vechen bishar yeme happesach korin bedillug kerashe chodashim: 
Ketzad medallegin. matchilin mittechillat hahallel ad <small>(Tehillim 114 8)</small> "challamish lemayeno mayim" umedalleg veomer <small>(Tehillim 115 12)</small> "Adonai zecharanu yevarech" kulei ad <small>(Tehillim 115 18)</small> "haleluyah" umedalleg veomer <small>(Tehillim 116 12)</small> "ma ashiv laAdonai" ad <small>(Tehillim 116 19)</small> "haleluyah" umedalleg veomer <small>(Tehillim 118 5)</small> "min hammetzar karati yah" ad sof hahallel. ze hu hamminhag happashut. veyesh medallegin dillug acher: 
Kol hayyom kasher likriat hahallel. vehakkore et hahallel lemafrea lo yatza. kara veshaha vechazar vekara af al pi sheshshaha kede ligmor et kullo yatza. yamim sheggomrin bahen et hahallel yesh lo lehafesik ben perek leferek aval beemtza happerek lo yafsik. veyamim shekkorin bahen bedillug afillu beemtza happerek posek: 
Kol yom sheggomrin bo et hahallel mevarech lefanav. umakom shennahagu levarech acharav mevarech. ketzad mevarech. yehallucha Adonai elohenu kol maasecha vetzaddikim vachasidim ose retzonecha vechol ammecha bet yisrael berinna yodu leshimcha ki atta Adonai lecha tov lehodot venaim leshimcha lezammer umeolam vead olam atta hael baruch atta Adonai hammelech hamehullal hameshubbach hamefoar chay vekayyam tamid yimloch leolam vaed: 
Yesh mekomot shennahagu lichpol me <small>(Tehillim 118 21)</small> "odcha ki anitani" ad sof hahallel koflin kol davar vedavar shete peamim. umakom shennahagu lichpol yichpol umakom shennahagu shello lichpol en koflin: 
Minhag keriat hahallel bime chachamim harishonim kach haya. achar shemmevarech haggadol shemmakre et hahallel matchil veomer haleluyah vechol haam onin haleluyah vechozer veomer halelu avde Adonai vechol haam onin haleluyah vechozer veomer halelu et shem Adonai vechol haam onin haleluyah vechozer veomer yehi shem Adonai mevorach meatta vead olam vechol haam onin haleluyah vechen al kol davar. ad shennimtzeu onin bechol hahallel haleluyah mea veshalosh veesrim peamim siman lahem shenotav shel aharon: 
Vechen keshehakkore maggia lerosh kol perek uferek hen chozrin veomrin ma sheamar. ketzad. keshehu omer betzet yisrael mimmitzrayim kol haam chozrin veomrin betzet yisrael mimmitzrayim. vehakkore omer bet yaakov meam loez vechol haam onin haleluyah ad sheyyomar ahavti ki yishma Adonai et koli tachanunay vechol haam chozrin veomrin ahavti ki yishma Adonai vechulei. vechen kesheyyomar hakkore halelu et Adonai kol goyim kol haam chozrin veomrin halelu et Adonai kol goyim: 
Hakkore omer anna Adonai hoshia na vehem onin acharav anna Adonai hoshia na. af al pi sheeno rosh perek. hu omer anna Adonai hatzelicha na vehem onim anna Adonai hatzelicha na. hu omer baruch habba vechol haam omrim baruch habba. veim haya hammakre et hahallel katan o eved o ishsha ona acharehem ma shehen omrin milla milla bechol hahallel. zehu hamminhag harishon uvo rauy lelech. aval bizmannim ellu raiti bechol hammekomot minhagot meshunnot bikriato uvaaniyyat haam veen echad mehem dome leechad:

Kamma nerot hu madlik bachanukka. mitzvatah sheyyihye kol bayit uvayit madlik ner echad ben shehayu anshe habbayit merubbin ben shello haya bo ella adam echad. vehamehadder et hammitzva madlik nerot keminyan anshe habbayit ner lechol echad veechad ben anashim ben nashim. vehamehadder yoter al ze veose mitzva min hammuvchar madlik ner lechol echad ballayla harishon umosif veholech bechol layla velayla ner echad: 
Ketzad. hare shehayu anshe habbayit asara. ballayla harishon madlik asara nerot uvelel sheni esrim uvelel shelishi sheloshim ad shennimtza madlik belel shemini shemonim nerot: 
Minhag pashut bechol arenu bisfarad sheyyihyu kol anshe habbayit madlikin ner echad ballayla harishon umosifin veholchin ner bechol layla ad shennimtza madlik belel shemini shemona nerot ben shehayu anshe habbayit merubbim ben shehaya adam echad: 
Ner sheyyesh lo shete piyyot ole lishne bene adam. mille keara shemen vehikkifah petilot. im kafa aleha keli kol petila ufetila nechshevet kener echad. lo kafa aleha keli naaset kimdura vaafillu kener echad enah nechshevet: 
En madlikin nerot chanukka kodem shettishka hachamma ella im shekiatah lo meacharin velo makdimin. shachach o hezid velo hidlik im shekiat hachamma madlik veholech ad shettichle regel min hashshuk. vechamma hu zeman ze kemo chatzi shaa o yeter. avar zeman ze eno madlik. vetzarich sheyyitten shemen banner kede shettihye doleket veholechet ad shettichle regel min hashshuk. hidlikah vechavta eno zakuk lehadelikah paam acheret. nishara doleket achar shekkalta regel min hashshuk im ratza lechabbotah o lesallekah ose: 
Kol hashshemanim vechol happetilot kesherot lener chanukka veaf al pi sheen hashshemanim nimshachim achar happetila veen haur nitlet yafe beotan happetilot. vaafillu belele shabbat shebbetoch yeme chanukka muttar lehadelik hashshemanim vehappetilot sheasur lehadelik bahen ner shabbat. lefi sheasur lehishtammesh lener chanukka ben beshabbat ben bechol vaafillu livdok maot o limnotan leorah asur: 
Ner chanukka mitzva lehannicho al petach beto mibbachutz battefach hassamuch lappetach al semol hannichnas labbayit kede shettihye mezuza miyyamin vener chanukka missemol. veim haya dar baaliyya mannicho bachallon hassemucha lirshut harabbim. vener chanukka shehinnicho lemala meesrim amma lo asa kelum lefi sheeno nikkar: 
Bime hassakkana manniach adam ner chanukka betoch beto mibbifnim vaafillu hinnicho al shulchano dayyo. vetzarich lihyot betoch habbayit ner acher lehishtammesh leoro. veim hayta sham medura eno tzarich ner acher. veim adam chashuv hu sheen darko lehishtammesh limdura tzarich ner acher: 
Ner chanukka shehidliko cheresh shote vekatan o akkum lo asa kelum ad sheyyadlikennu mi shehu chayyav bahadelaka. hidliko mibbifnim vehotzio daluk vehinnicho al petach beto lo asa kelum ad sheyyadlikennu bimkomo. achaz hanner beyado veamad lo asa kelum sheharoe omer letzarko hu omed. ashashit shehayta doleket kol hayyom kullo lemotzae shabbat mechabbe umevarech umadlikah shehahadlaka hi hammitzva velo hahannacha. umuttar lehadelik ner chanukka minner chanukka: 
Chatzer sheyyesh lah shene petachim bishte ruchot tzericha shete nerot. shemma yomru haovrim beruach zo lo hinniach ner chanukka. aval im hayu beruach achat madlik beechad mehen: 
Oreach shemmadlikin alav betoch beto eno tzarich lehadelik alav bemakom shennitareach bo. en lo bayit lehadelik alav bo tzarich lehadelik bammakom shennitareach bo. umishtattef immahen bashshemen. veim haya lo bayit bifne atzmo af al pi shemmadlikin alav betoch beto tzarich lehadelik babbayit shehu bo mippene haovrin: 
Mitzvat ner chanukka mitzva chaviva hi ad meod vetzarich adam lehizzaher bah kede lehodia hannes ulehosif beshevach hael vehodaya lo al hannissim sheasa lanu. afillu en lo ma yochal ella min hatztzedaka shoel o mocher kesuto velokeach shemen venerot umadlik: 
Hare sheen lo ella peruta achat ulefanav kiddush hayyom vehadelakat ner chanukka makdim liknot shemen lehadelik ner chanukka al hayyayin lekiddush hayyom. hoil ushenehem middivre sofrim mutav lehakedim ner chanukka sheyyesh bo zichron hannes: 
Haya lefanav ner beto vener chanukka o ner beto vekiddush hayyom ner beto kodem mishshum shelom beto shehare hashshem nimchak laasot shalom ben ish leishto. gadol hashshalom shekkol hattora nittena laasot shalom baolam shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 3 17)</small> "deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom":
Mishneh Torah, Second Tithes and Fourth:
Achar shemmafrishin maaser rishon bechol shana mafrishin maaser sheni shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 22)</small> "asser teasser et kol tevuat zarecha". uveshana shelishit veshishshit mafrishin maasar ani chelef maaser sheni kemo shebbearnu: 
Beechad betishre hu rosh hashshana lemaasar tevuot vekitniyyot virakot. vechol makom shenneemar rosh hashshana hu echad betishre. uvetv bishvat hu rosh hashshana lemaasar hailanot. ketzad. tevua vekitniyyot shehiggiu leonat hammaasrot lifne rosh hashshana shel shelishit af al pi shennigmeru veneesfu bashshelishit mafrishin mehen maaser sheni. veim lo bau leonat hammaasrot ella leachar rosh hashshana shel shelishit mafrishin mehen maasar ani. vechen perot hailan shebbau leonat hammaasrot kodem 15 bishvat shel shelishit af al pi shennigmeru veneesfu achar ken besof shana shelishit mitasserin lesheavar umafrishin mehen maaser sheni. vechen im bau leonat hammaasrot kodem 15 bishvat shel reviit af al pi shennigmeru veneesfu birviit mafrishin mehen maaser ani. veim bau leonat hammaasrot achar 15 bishvat mitasserin lehabba: 
Vehecharuvin af al pi shechantu perotehen kodem 15 bishvat mitasserin lehabba. hoil umitasserot middivre sofrim. yerae li sheen haddevarim amurin ella becharuve tzalmona vechayyotze bahen sheen reuyin lemaachal rov haadam. vehen hen shemmitasserot middivre sofrim. aval shear hecharuvin yerae li shehen kishar perot hailan: 
Hayyarak bishat lekitato issuro. ketzad. im nilkat beyom rosh hashshana shel shelishit af al pi shebba leonat hammaasrot venigmar bashsheniyya mafrishin mimmennu maasar ani. veim nilkat barviit maaser sheni: 
Vechen haetrog bilvad mishshear perot hailan hare hu keyarak veholchin achar lekitato ben lemaaser ben lishviit. ketzad. im nilkat bashshelishit achar 15 bishvat mafrishin mimmennu maasar ani af al pi shennigmera bashsheniyya. vechen im nilkat barviit kodem 15 bishvat mafrishin mimmennu maasar ani. nilkat barviit achar 15 bishvat mafrishin mimmennu maaser sheni: 
Veaf al pi sheholchin achar lekitato etrog bat shishshit shennichnesa lashsheviit afillu hayta kezayit venaaset kechikkar chayyevet bemaasrot: 
Haevyonot shel tzalaf notnin alehen chumre ilan vechumre zeraim. sheim hayu mishshana sheniyya shennichnesa lashshelishit venilketu kodem 15 bishvat mafrishin maaser rishon veachar kach mafrish maaser acher ufodehu. veachar sheppodehu notno laaniyyim veochel pidyono betorat maaser sheni. venimtza kemo shehifrish maaser sheni umaasar ani: 
Haorez vehaddochan vehapperagin vehashshumshemin af al pi shehishrishu kodem rosh hashshana en holchin bahen ella achar gemar happeri umitasserin lehabba. vechen pol hammitzri af al pi shemmiktzato hishrish lifne rosh hashshana umiktzato leacharav tzover garno letocho vetorem umeasser min hakkol keechad shehakkol holech achar gemar happeri: 
Habbetzalim hassarisim shemmana mehem mayim sheloshim yom lifne rosh hashshana. veshel baal shemmana mehem shalosh onot lifne rosh hashshana. mitasserin lesheavar. mana mehem pachot mikkan af al pi shehitchilu livash kodem rosh hashshana mitasserin lehabba: 
Pol hammitzri shehevi shelish lifne rosh hashshana im zerao lezera mitasser lesheavar. zerao leyarak mitasser lehabba. zaro lezera uleyarak o shezzerao lezera vechishshev alav leyarak measser mizzaro al yerako umirako al zaro. lo hevi shelish lifne rosh hashshana im zerao lezera zaro mitasser lesheavar virako bishat lekitato issuro. vehu shellikket mimmennu lifne rosh hashshana. aval im likket mimmennu achar rosh hashshana ben yerako ben zaro mitasser lehabba. zerao lezera vechishshev alav leyarak holchin achar machashavto. zerao leyarak vechishshev alav lezara en machashevet zera chala alav ella im ken mana mimmennu shalosh arayot. vehu shehevi shelish lifne rosh hashshana aval im lo hevi shelish ella leacharav af al pi shello nimna milleerot mimmennu shalosh arayot. zaro lezera veasa kullo katztzatzin gemurim lifne rosh hashshana zaro mitasser lesheavar. virako bishat lekitato. miktzato asa katztzatzin gemurin umiktzato lo asa. ze sheamru tzover garno letocho venimtza measser mizzaro al yerako umirako al zaro: 
Perot shana sheniyya shennitarvu beferot shelishit. o shel shelishit birviit. holchin achar harov. mechetza lemechetza mafrish maaser sheni min hakkol. aval lo maasar ani shemmaaser sheni chamur shehare hu kodesh umaasar ani chol. vechen perot shehen safek im perot sheniyya hem o perot shelishit mafrish mehen maaser sheni: 
Kol happetur mimmaaser rishon patur min hashsheni umin heani. vechol shechayyav berishon chayyav bishnehem. vechol hattorem motzi maaser. vechol sheeno torem eno motzi maaser ze. kol mi sheim taram terumato teruma kach im isser maaser ze hare hu maaser. vechol mi sheen terumato teruma kach im hotzi maaser ze eno maaser: 
Perot shehotzi mehen maaser rishon kodem sheyyikkavu lammaaser hare ze ochel mehen aray kodem sheyyotzi maaser sheni. sheen harishon kovea lashsheni. aval mishshennikbeu lemaaser af al pi shehotzi et harishon asur leechol mehen aray ad sheyyotzi et hashsheni o et maasar ani: 
Maaser sheni hoil vetaun havaat makom en meviin oto michutza laaretz kivchor behema. lefichach lo chiyyevu lehaferish maaser sheni besureya. veyerae li shemmaaser sheni shemmafrishim beeretz shinar uvemitzrayim podin oto umeviin damav lirushalayim. vechen yerae li shello chiyyevu mekomot ellu bemaaser sheni ella kede likboa maaser ani kede sheyyihyu aniyye yisrael somchim alehem:

Maaser sheni neechol livalav lefanim mechomat yerushalayim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha bammakom asher yivchar leshakken shemo sham" vegomer. venoheg bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit aval eno neechol birushalayim ella bifne habbayit shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzoncha". mippi hashshemua lamdu ma bechor eno neechol ella bifne habbayit af maaser sheni lo yeachel ella bifne habbayit: 
Middat chasidut sheppodin maaser sheni bazzeman hazze beshavyo kederech sheppodin oto bifne habbayit. vehoru haggeonim sheim ratza lifdot sheve mane bifruta lechattechilla bazzeman hazze pode. lo yihye ze chamur min hakkodesh. umashlich happeruta layyam haggadol: 
Vechen im chillel maaser sheve mane al sheve peruta mipperot acherot hare ze mechullal. vesoref et happerot shechillel alehem kede shello yihyu takkala laacherim. kefidyon neta revai bazzeman hazze kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure maachalot: 
Keshem sheen ochlin maaser sheni bazzeman hazze birushalayim kach en podin oto sham. veen mechallelin oto veen mochrin oto. veim nichnas birushalayim af bazzeman hazze en motziin oto mishsham umannichim oto sham ad sheyyerakev vechen im avar vehotzio mishsham mannichin oto ad sheyyerakev. lefichach en mafrishim maaser sheni birushalayim bazzeman hazze ella motziin et happerot betivlan chutz lair umafrishin oto sham ufodehu. veim hifrishu sham bazzeman hazze yerakev: 
Kol haochel kezayit maaser sheni o sheshshata mimmennu reviit yayin chutz lechomat yerushalayim loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha" vegomer. veloke al kol echad veechad bifne atzmo. lefichach im achal shelashtan chutz lachoma loke shalosh malkiyyot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha" masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha veneemar lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha vegomer lamma peratan velo amar lo tochlem bisharecha lechayyev al kol echad veechad bifne atzmo: 
Eno loke min hattora ad sheyyochlennu achar shennichnas lechomat yerushalayim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha" vegomer <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha". kevan shennichnas limkom achilato vaachalo bachutz loke. aval im achalo kodem sheyyikkansu lirushalayim makkin oto makkat mardut middivrehem: 
Miktzat maaser bifnim umiktzato mibbachutz haochel mizze sheadayin lo nichnas makkin oto makkat mardut. vehaochel bachutz mizze shennichnas loke: 
En podin maaser sheni birushalayim ella im ken nitma shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 24)</small> "ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom" berichuk makom hu nifde veeno nifde bekeruv makom. haya hu bifnim umassao bachutz afillu haya ochez oto bekane hoil velo nichnas hammaaser hare ze muttar lifdoto sham betzad hachoma: 
Maaser sheni shennichnas lirushalayim afillu shel demay asur lehotzio mishsham shekkevar kelatuhu mechitztzot. vechen perot hannilkachin bechesef maaser shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha". avar vehotzian o sheyyatzu bishgaga yachzeru veyeachlu birushalayim. ukelitat mechitztzot middivrehem afillu maaser sheen bechumsho sheve peruta shehu middivrehem mechitztzot koltot oto veasur lehotzio. aval meot maaser sheni nichnasin lirushalayim veyotzin: 
Perot shennigmera melachtan veavru betoch yerushalayim veyatzu eno yachol lehotzi alehen maaser sheni mipperot acherot shello nichnesu lirushalayim. ella yachazor maaser sheni shellahen veyeachel birushalayim veeno nifde bachutz. afillu asa kol happerot haellu maaser sheni achar sheyyatzu al perot acherot shello nichnesu yachzeru veyeachlu birushalayim. chomer hu bimchitztzot yerushalayim hoil vekaltu kaltu: 
Perot shello nigmera melachtan sheavru birushalayim veyatzu. kegon salle anavim legat vesalle teenim bemuktze. muttar lifdot maaser sheni shellahem bachutz. vechen perot demay af al pi shennigmera melachtan veavru birushalayim veyatzu podin maaser sheni shellahen bachutz: 
Perot maaser sheni shennitmeu birushalayim ufedaan im nitmeu bivlad hattuma asur lehotzian. ella yeachlu bifnim mippene shevvelad hattuma middivrehem. veim nitmeu beav hattuma o shennitmeu bachutz vaafillu bivlad hattuma af al pi shennichnesu lirushalayim hare ellu nifdin veneechalin bechol makom: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehichnisan al menat shello titpesem hammechitztzot. aval im lo hitna hoil venichnas hare hu tahor min hattora [sheen valad metamme sheni min hattora] uchevar kelatuhu mechitztzot veeno yotze: 
Tiltan shel maaser sheni muttar leachlah tzimchonin shekkach hi reuya laachila. vechen karshine maaser sheni yeachlu tzimchonin. veim asa mehem issa hare zo mutteret lehikkanes lirushalayim ulehotziah sheenan bichlal happerot. veim nitmeu birushalayim yippadu veyeachlu bachutz: 
Ilan sheomed lefanim min hachoma venofo note chutz lachoma en ochlin tachat nofo maaser sheni. umaaser sheni shennichnas tachat nofo en podin oto shehare hu kemi shennichnas lirushalayim: 
Battim shebbetzad hachoma sheppitchehem lefanim min hachoma vachalalan lechutz. mikkeneged hachoma ulefanim kilfanim lechol davar umikkeneged hachoma velachutz en ochlim sham veen podin sham lehachamir. haya chalalan lefanim ufitchehem lachutz. mikkeneged hachoma velachutz kelachutz podin bo veen ochlin. umikkeneged hachoma velifnim en ochlin sham veen podin lehachamir. vehachallonot voovi hachoma kilfanim:

Haochel maaser sheni betuma loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 14)</small> "velo viarti mimmennu betame". ben shehammaaser tame vehaochel tahor. ben shehammaaser tahor vehaochel tame. vehu sheyyochlennu birushalayim kodem sheyyippade. sheeno loke al achilato betuma ella bimkom achilato. aval im achalo betuma chutz lirushalayim makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Vaafillu lehadelik [bo] et hanner achar shennitma asur ad sheyyippade shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 14)</small> "lo viarti mimmennu betame": 
Kevar bearnu shehammaaser shennitma afillu birushalayim podin veyeachel. veochlin et damav betohora betorat perot maaser kemo sheyyitbaer. afillu nitmeu happerot kullan keshehen tevel mafrish maaser sheni betuma ufodehu: 
Hearel ketame veim achal maaser sheni loke min hattora kederech shelloke al achilat teruma. shehatteruma keruya kodesh umaaser sheni karuy kodesh shehare neemar bo <small>(Vayikra 27 30)</small> "kodesh laAdonai". vetame shettaval ochel maaser sheni af al pi shello heeriv shimsho: 
Haochel maaser sheni baaninut shel tora loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 14)</small> "lo achalti veoni mimmennu". vehu sheyyochlennu bemakom achilato birushalayim. aval im achalo bachutz baaninut. o sheachalo bifnim baaninut shel divrehem. makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Ezehu onen ze hammitabbel al echad min hakkerovim shehu chayyav lehitabbel alehen. uveyom hammita hu onen min hattora uvallayla onen middivrehen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 10 19)</small> "veachalti chattat hayyom hayyitav beene Adonai". hayyom asur velayla muttar. nishtaha hammet yamim rabbim veachar kach nikbar. kol otan hayyamim sheachar yom hammita ad yom hakkevura hu onen middivrehen. veen yom hakkevura tofes lelo: 
Velo maaser sheni bilvad ella kol hakkadashim kullan im achalan baaninut shel tora loke. uvaaninut shel divrehen makkin oto makkat mardut: 
En notnin perot maaser sheni leam haaretz velo perot hannilkachot bimot maaser velo meot maaser mippene shehu bechezkat tuma. umuttar leechol maaser sheni shel demay baaninut velitteno leam haaretz vehu sheyyochal kenegdo. en mafkidin maaser sheni afillu etzel chaver shemma yamut venimtza hammaaser tachat yad beno am haaretz. aval mafkidim maaser sheni shel demay etzel am haaretz: 
Maaser sheni asur leabbed afillu miuto badderachim. ella molicho kol shehu o molich damav lirushalayim. umuttar leabbed miut maaser sheni shel demay badderachim. vechamma hi miut pachot mikkigrogeret ben beochel shalem ben befarus. aval kigrogeret en meabbedin oto. vehammafrish maaser sheni shel demay pachot mikkigrogeret hare ze notno leam haaretz veochel kenegdo aval lo yafrishennu lechattechilla leabbedo sheen mafrishin leabbed: 
Maaser sheni nittan laachila ushetiyya shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha". vesicha kishtiyya. veasur lehotzio bishar tzerachav kegon likkach bo kelim uvegadim vaavadim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 14)</small> "lo natatti mimmennu lemet" kelomar lo hotzeti oto bedavar sheeno mekayyem et hagguf. veim hotzi mimmennu bishar devarim afillu bidvar mitzva kegon shellakach mimmennu aron vetachrichin lemet mitzva hare ze ochel kenegdo betorat maaser: 
Maaser ochel davar sheddarko leheachel veshote davar sheddarko lishtot vesach davar sheddarko lasuch. velo yasuch yayin vechometz aval sach hu et hashshemen. velo yischot et happerot lehotzi mehen mashkin chutz mizzetim vaanavim bilvad. [veen mefattemin et hashshemen aval mefattemin et hayyayin]. veen mechayyevin oto leechol pat sheippesha veshemen shennisrach. ella kevan shennifsal meochel adam paka kedushsha mimmennu: 
Kol shemmuttar lezarim leachlo bitruma kach muttar bemaaser sheni leachlo betorat chullin. shemarim shel maaser sheni shennatan alehem mayim. rishon asur kemaaser vesheni muttar kechullin. veshel demay afillu rishon muttar: 
Yayin shel maaser shennafal letocho devash vehattavlin vehishbichu hashshevach lefi cheshbon. vechen dagim shennitbashshelu im kaflotot shel maaser sheni vehishbichu hashshevach lefi cheshbon: 
Issa shel maaser sheni sheafaah vehishbicha hashshevach lashsheni. ze hakkelal kol sheshshivcho nikkar im hotir bemidda hashshevach lefi cheshbon. veim lo hotir hammidda hashshevach lashsheni bilvad. vechol sheen shivcho nikkar afillu hotir hammidda hashshevach lashsheni bilvad: 
Ketzad hashshevach. lefi cheshbon. yayin shel maaser sheshshave shelosha shennafal letocho devash vetavlin shave zuz echad vehosifa bemiddato vehishbichuhu vahare hakkol shave chamishsha choshvin hakkol bearbaa urevia. vechen al derech ze bishar haddevarim: 
Maaser sheni af al pi shennittan lesicha en notnin oto lo al gabbe tzinit velo al gabbe chazazit. veen osin mimmennu kamea vechayyotze bo shehare lo nittan lirfua: 
Maaser sheni mamon gavoah hu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 30)</small> "laAdonai hu". lefichach eno nikne bemattana ella im ken natan lo hattevel vehamekabbel mafrish hammaaser. veen mekaddeshin bo et haishsha veen mochrin oto veen memashkenin oto veen machlifin oto veen marhinin oto: 
Ketzad en memashkenin oto. lo yikkanes leveto vimashkenennu maaser sheni shello. avar umishkeno motziin oto miyyado. ketzad en marhinin oto. lo yomar lo he lecha maaser ze veyihye beyadcha veten li alav maot. ketzad en machlifin oto. lo yomar lo he lecha yen maaser veten li shemen maaser. aval omer lo he lecha yayin sheen li shemen veim ratza chavero litten lo shemen muttar shehare lo hechelif immo ella hodio sheen lo veim ratza halla litten yitten: 
Maaser sheni en shoklin kenegdo afillu dinre zahav. vaafillu lechallel alehem maaser sheni acher gezera shemma lo yechavven mimmennu mishkalo venimtzeu happerot chaserim vehu shokel bahen maot lechallel alehem maaser acher nimtza motzi maaser lechullin befachot bedamav: 
Haachim shechalku maaser sheni en shoklin ze keneged ze vechen meot maaser sheni en shoklim kenegdan veen mochrin otam veen machlifin velo marhinin. velo yittenem leshulchani lehitnaot bahen velo yalve otan lehitgaddel bahen. veim hilvan shello yaale chaludda muttar: 
Veen porin mehem et hammilve. en osin mehen shoshvinut veen meshallemin mehen haggemulin. veen poskin mehem tzedaka bevet hakkeneset. aval meshallemin mehen devarim shehen gemilut chasadim. vetzarich lehodia: 
Lo yomar adam lachavero haal et happerot haellu lirushalayim vetol mehen chelkecha shennimtza ze kenotel sachar mimmaaser sheni al havaato lirushalayim. aval omer lo haelem shennochlem veshennishtem birushalayim: 
Omer adam lachavero birushalayim lasuch oto beshemen maaser sheni af al pi shennissocha yado veen ze bischar sichato: 
Kevar bearnu shehammaaser mamon gavoah hu. lefichach anu omrim shehaggonev maaser sheni eno meshallem tashlume kefel vehaggozlo eno meshallem chomesh: 
Hammakdish maaser sheni shello levedek habbayit hare ze pode oto mi sheppodehu al menat litten lahekdesh et shello ulemaaser sheni et shello:

Harotze lifdot perot maaser sheni pode otan bidmehen veomer hare hammaot haellu tachat happerot haellu o happerot haellu mechullalot al hammaot haellu. veim lo peresh ella hifrish maot bilvad keneged happerot dayyo veeno tzarich lefaresh veyetzu happerot lechullin. veyaalu hammaot lirushalayim veyotziem sham shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 24)</small> "vechi yirbe mimmecha hadderech ki lo tuchal seeto":

Vechen im ratza lechallel perot hammaaser al perot acherot. yaalu happerot hashsheniyyot veyeachlu birushalayim. velo yechallel mimmin al sheeno mino velo min hayyafe al hara vaafillu beoto hammin. veim chillel hare hen mechullalot:
