Happode maaser sheni mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al pidyon maaser sheni. veim chillelan al perot acherot o shechillel maot al happerot mevarech al chillul maaser sheni. vehappode o hamechallel maaser sheni shel demay eno tzarich beracha:
Kesheppodin et hammaaser en podin oto leshem maaser ella leshem chullin. veomrin kamma shavin perot chullin ellu veaf al pi shehakkol yodin shehen maaser kede shello yitbazze:

En mechallelin meot maaser sheni al maot acherot. ben shehayu ellu veellu kesef o ellu veellu nechoshet. [o harishonot kesef vehashsheniyyot nechoshet. o] harishonot nechoshet vehashsheniyyot kesef. veim avar vechillel hare ellu mechullalin:

En mechallelin maot maaser al happerot. veim chillel yaalu happerot veyeachlu birushalayim. velo yechallelem al behema chayya veof chayyin. veim chillel lo kana maaser shemma yegaddel mehem adarim adarim. aval im chillel al shechutim hare hen kishar happerot veyaalu veyeachlu birushalayim veyetzu hammaot lechullin:
Bishat haddechak muttar lechallel maot hakkesef al shel nechoshet. lo sheyyekayyem ken ella ad sheyyimtza revach. veyachazor vichallel maot hannechoshet al maot hakkesef:
Maaser sheni shel demay mechallelim oto lechattechilla kesef al kesef vechesef al nechoshet unechoshet al nechoshet unechoshet al happerot veyaalu otan happerot veyeachlu birushalayim:

En podin perot maaser ella bechesef shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 25)</small> "vetzarta hakkesef". vechen im pada leatzmo vehosif chomesh lo yihye hachomesh ella kesef kakkeren. veen podin bechesef sheeno matbea ella bechesef mefuttach sheyyesh alav tzura o ketav [shenneemar vetzarta hakkesef]. veim pada belashon shel kesef vechayyotze bo vehu hannikra asimon lo asa kelum. veen podin befachot mipperuta mippene shehu kefode baasimon:

En podin bematbea sheeno yotze beoto zeman uveoto makom shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 26)</small> "venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teavve nafshecha" ad sheyyihye rauy lehotzaa. umatbea melachim harishonim im yotze mishshemam podin bo:
Eno pode bemaot sheenan birshuto shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 25)</small> "vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha". nafal kiso levor vehu yachol lehotzio pode bo mippene shehu birshuto:

Haya ba badderech umaot beyado veannas ba kenegdo im yachol lehatztzil al yede haddechak pode bahen perot shebbeveto. veim lav veamar perot sheyyesh li betoch beti mechullalin al hammaot hallalu lo amar kelum:
Hammeniach maot lihyot mechallel alehen maaser sheni hare ze pode bahen bechezkat shehen kayyamim. metzaan sheavdu choshesh lechol ma sheppada bahen lemafrea:
Mi shehaya omed bitverya veyesh lo maot (bavel) bevavel eno mechallel alehem. hayu lo maot mimmatbea teverya bevavel mechallel alehem. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Haomer maaser sheni mechullal al sela shettaale beyadi mikkis ze al sela sheefrot middinar zahav ze al punedyon sheefrot missela ze hare ze chillel. vesela shettaale beyado o sheyyifrot tehi maaser:
Amar hare maaser mechullal al sela shehayta beyad beni lo chillel. shemma lo hayta beyado beotah shaa:

Happode maaser sheni kodem sheyyafrishennu kegon sheamar maaser sheni shel perot ellu paduy bemaot ellu lo amar kelum velo kava maaser. aval im kava veamar maaser sheni shellahen batztzafon o baddarom mechullal al hammaot ellu hare ze paduy:

Kesheppodin maaser sheni podin oto beshavyo. veyesh lo lifdot bashshaar hazzol kemot shehachenvani lokeach velo kemot shehu mocher. venoten hammaot kemot shehashshulchani poret lo kemot shehu metzaref. veim avar ufada sheve mane bifruta o chillel sheve mane al sheve peruta hare ze mechullal:
Hayta hassela chasera shetut o pachot mishshetut im hayta yotzet al yede haddechak mechallel aleha lechattechilla bishve sela veeno choshesh. pada besela venimtzet raa yachalifenna:

En podin maaser sheni achsara ella medakdek bemiddato o bemishkalo venoten damav. im hayu damav yeduim yippade al pi echad. veim davar sheen damav yeduim kegon yayin shehitchil lehachamitz uferot shehirkivu o maot shehechelidu yippade al pi shelosha taggarim vaafillu haya echad mehen akkum o baal hammaaser afillu ish ushete nashav podin al pihem. vechofin et habbealim liftoach rishon. veze chomer bemaaser min hahekdesh:

En molichin perot maaser mimmakom lemakom lifdotam sham. vehammolich mimmekom hayyoker lammakom hazzol o mimmakom hazzol limkom hayyoker pode keshaar mekom happediyya. veim hayu demay podin oto kashshaar hazzol hoil veniru lehimmacher bezol:
Hayu lo perot maaser sheni baggoren vehotzi alehem yetziot mibbeto ad shehevian lair vehishbichu. pode keshaar hair vehifsid yetziotav:

Happode maasro leatzmo ben shehu shello ben shennafal lo birushsha ben shennittan lo betivlo mattana kemo shebbearnu. hare ze mosif alav chomesh. im haya shave arbaa noten chamishsha. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 lo)</small> "veim gal yigal ish mimmaasro chamishito yosef alav": 
Veishsha sheppadat maaser sheni shellah leatzmah enah mosifa chomesh. mippi hashshemua lamdu <small>(Vayikra 27 lo)</small> "ish mimmaasro" velo ishsha. vechen im pada pidyon perot hammaaser leatzmo mosif chomesh: 
Pada perot maasro vehosif chomesh vechazar ufada happidyon leatzmo paam sheniyya mosif chomesh sheni al hakkeren bilvad veeno mosif chomesh al hachomesh: 
Maaser sheni sheen bechumsho sheve peruta eno mosif alav chomesh. vechen maaser sheen damav yeduin dayyo sheyyomar hu vechumsho mechullal al hassela hazze. vechol maaser shehu eno podehu mishshello eno mosif chomesh. umaaser sheni shel demay eno mosif alav chomesh: 
Happode maaser sheni vehaya lo maaser sheni acher shello nifda. im en bechumsho sheve peruta dayyo sheyyomar hu vechumsho mechullal al maot harishonot lefi shei efshar leadam letzamtzem et meotav: 
Happode maaser beyoter al damav lo nitpesa hattosefet lamaaser: 
Baal habbayit omer besela veacher omer besela. baal habbayit kodem mippene shehu mosif chomesh. baal habbayit omer besela veacher omer besela uferuta. haacher kodem mippene shemmosif al hakkeren: 
Muttar lehaarim al pidyon maasro. ketzad. omer livno ulevitto haggedolim uleavdo haivri he lecha et hammaot haellu ufede lecha bahen hammaaser kede shello yosif chomesh. aval lo yomar lo pede li bahen. vechen im amar lo pede li mishshellecha eno mosif chomesh: 
Aval lo yitten hammaot lifdot livno ulevitto hakketannim uleavdo veshifchato hakkenaanim mippene sheyyadan keyado. natan leshifchato haivriyya im maaser sheni ze middivrehem kegon shehaya meatzitz sheeno nakuv devarav kayyamin. sheama haivriyya ketanna hi veen hakkatan zoche laacherim ella bedavar shehu middivrehem: 
Vechen maarim venoten hammaaser mattana keshehu betivlo. veomer hannoten hare happerot haellu mechullalin al maot shebbabbayit: 
Shene achin o shene shuttafin [av uveno] podin ze laze maaser sheni kede shello yosif chomesh. ishsha shehichnisa levalah maaser sheni hoil vehu mamon gavoah kemo shebbearnu lo kana baal. lefichach im padahu eno mosif chomesh: 
Happode maaser sheni leatzmo venatan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh. af al pi sheen hachomesh meakkev vahare nitchallel lo yochal ad sheyyitten hachomesh vaafillu beshabbat gezera shemma yifsha velo yitten: 
Maot maaser sheni im ratza letzarfam bedinre zahav kede lehakel massaan metzarfan. veim tzerfan leatzmo eno mosif chomesh sheen ze derech pediyya: 
Happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni ben birushalayim ben chutz lirushalayim lo yetzarfenna kullah bemaot nechoshet ella beshekel maot kesef uveshekel maot nechoshet: 
Muttar lechallel kesef maaser im perot maaser al hakkesef vehu sheyyehu bapperot pachot mishsheve dinar. aval im haya bahen sheve dinar lo yechallelem im hakkesef ella bifne atzman. ketzad. hayu lo perot sheve dinar ushelosha dinarin shel maaser sheni eno mechallel hakkol al sela achat. aval im haya lo chatzi dinar perot vachatzi dinar maot mechallel shenehem al dinar echad:

Meot chullin umeot maaser shennitpazzeru velikket mikkan umikkan. ma shellikket likket lemaaser ad sheyyashlim. vehashshear chullin. veim balal vechafan o shellikket mitztzad echad umatza chaser hare ze lefi cheshbon. ketzad. hayu matayim maaser sheni umea chullin. nitpazzeru uvelalan vechafan hakkol nimtzeu matayim veshivim. hare mea ushemonim mehen maaser vetishim chullin. ze hakkelal hammitlakketin lemaaser sheni vehannivlalin lefi cheshbon. matne veomer im ellu shebbeyadi hen hammaaser hashshear chullin. veim hen chullin hare meot hammaaser bechol makom shehen mechullalin alehem: 
Sela shel maaser sheni veshel chulliyin shennitarvu mevi bassela maot vaafillu meot nechoshet veomer sela shel maaser sheni bechol makom shehi mechullelet al hammaot haellu. veachar kach borer et hayyafe shebbishtehen umechallel hammaot shel nechoshet aleha vetachazor hassela hayyafa lemaaser: 
Haomer livno maaser sheni bezavit zo venimtza bezavit acheret hare ellu chullin. amar lo hare sham mane venimtza matayim hashshear chullin. hare sham matayim venimtza mane hare hu chullin. hinniach mane maaser venimtza matayim. matayim venimtza mane. afillu hen bishne kisin hakkol chullin: 
Amar lo aviv kis maaser sheni li babbayit. halach umatza sham shelosha kisim. haggadol shebbechullan maaser vehashshear chullin. veaf al pi chen lo yochal min hakketannim ad sheyyechallelem al haggadol: 
Mi shennishtattek veamru lo maaser sheni shellecha bemakom peloni. vehirkin berosho. bodkin oto shalosh peamim kederech shebbodkin legittin vahare devarav kayyamin: 
Amru lo bachalom maaser sheni shel avicha sheatta mevakkesh hare hu bemakom peloni. af al pi shemmatza sham ma shenneemar lo eno maaser. divre chalomot lo maalin velo moridin: 
Haomer levanav afillu attem metim al tiggeu bezavit zo. venimtzeu sham maot hare ellu chullin. taman maot mippenehem veamar lahem shel peloni hen o shel maaser sheni hen. im kemaarim en choshshin lidvarav. veim kemitkavven devarav kayyamin: 
Hammotze keli vechatuv alav 40 hare ma shebbetocho maaser sheni. 4 demay. 9 tevel. 400 teruma. 100 karban. veim haya shel mattechet hu uma shebbetocho karban. shekken hayu kotvin ot achat min hashshem bishat hassakkana: 
Maot hannimtzaot birushalayim afillu dinre zahav im hakkesef veim hammaot hare ellu chullin. hoil veshuke yerushalayim mitkabbedin bechol yom. matza betochan cheres vechatuv bo maaser hare ellu maaser sheni. bamme devarim amurim bishar yemot hashshana. aval baregel hakkol maaser: 
Maot hannimtzaot lifne sochare behema birushalayim leolam maaser. shechezkat rov haam meviin meot maaser vekonin bo behemot. vehannimtzaot behar habbayit leolam chullin. shechezkatan mitterumat hallishka shechillelum haggizbarin al behema: 
Teva shennishtammesh bah chullin umaaser sheni. venimtza betochah maot. im rov mannichin maaser hare hammaot maaser. veim rov mannichin chullin chullin. mechetza lemechetza chullin: 
Matza perot ben perot maaser leferot teruma yippelu lakkarov. mechetza lemechetza yeachlu kechumre shenehen. asurin lezarim uteunin rechitzat yadayim vehaarev shemesh kitruma. vaasurim leonen uteunim havaat makom kemaaser. vechen hammaot hannimtzaot ben chullin lemaaser: 
Maaser sheni shel demay veshel vadday shennitarvu yeachlu kechamur shebbahen: 
Perot maaser shennitarvu beferot chullin yochal hakkol betohora bammakom o yifde et hammaaser. lefichach im nitarvu birushalayim asurin bechol shehen keminyan. hoil vehu birushalayim hare hu kedavar sheyyesh lo mattirin. veyeachel hakkol betohora: 
Hazzorea maaser sheni achar shennichnas lirushalayim haggiddulim maaser sheni. zerao kodem sheyyikkanes haggiddulin chullin. vaafillu bedavar sheen zaro kale. ufodin oto bishat zeriato: 
Maaser sheni batel berov. beeze maaser amru bemaaser shennichnas lirushalayim veyatza venaflu mechitztzot. shehare en sham mechitztzot lehachaziro lesham vei efshar lifdoto meachar shennichnas veaf al pi sheen bo sheve peruta venimtza davar sheen lo mattirin uvatel berov kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure maachalot:

Perot hannilkachot bechesef maaser sheni enan nifdin berichuk makom ella im ken nitmeu beav hattuma ella yaalu hen atzman veyeachlu birushalayim: 
Ze chomer belakuach bechesef maaser mipperot maaser atzman. veim nitma bivlad hattuma middivrehem yippadu veyeachlu birushalayim: 
En nilkach bechesef maaser ella maachal adam sheggiddulav min haaretz. o giddule giddulav min haaretz. kegon happerat hameforash battora <small>(Devarim 14 26)</small> "babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar": 
Lefichach en lokchin bechesef maaser mayim umelach kemehin ufitriyyot lefi sheen giddulehem min haaretz. velo perot mechubbarin lakkarka. velo perot sheenan yecholim lehaggia lirushalayim. lefi sheenan domin levakar vatzon: 
Haddevash vehabbetzim vehechalav hare hen kevakar vatzon sheaf al pi sheenan giddule karka hare hen giddule gidduleha: 
Hattemed ad shello hechmitz eno nilkach bechesef maaser mippene shehu kemayim. umishshehechmitz nilkach kayyayin ucheshechar. lekacho ad shello hechmitz vehechemitz kana maaser: 
Bamme devarim amurim benatan shelosha mayim umatza pachot mearbaa. aval im natan shelosha vehotzi arbaa hare ze keyayin mazug venilkach bechesef maaser: 
Luleve zeradin vehecharuvin ad shello yamtiku en nilkachin. achar sheyyamtiku nilkachin. aval halluf vehachardal vehatturmusin ushear kol hannichbashim ben mishsheyyamtiku ben ad shello himtiku nilkachin. vehakkor nilkach bechesef maaser: 
Hakkarkom eno nilkach sheeno ella lemare. vechen kol kayyotze bo minnotne reach umare vetaam hoil veenan laachilat gufan ella letaam shennotnin enan nilkachin bechesef maaser. lefichach rashe besamim vehappilpelin vehakkosht vehachiltit vechallot charia vechol kayyotze baellu enan nilkachin bechesef maaser: 
Hashshevet im litten taam bikdera enah nilkachat bechesef maaser. veim lichmach vechayyotze bo shehu ochel gufah nilkachat bechesef maaser. erev mayim umelach im natan letocho shemen hare hen kemuryas velokeach mehen bechesef maaser. umavlia deme hammayim vehammelach bidme hashshemen: 
En lokchin terumot bechesef maaser mippene shehu memaet achilato vaachilatah. sheen ochlin otah ella kohanim meorve shemesh umutteret leonen veneechelet bechol makom. vehammaaser muttar lezarim velitvul yom veasur leonen veeno neechol ella birushalayim. nimtza memaet achilat maaser vaachilat hatteruma: 
Lokchin behema lezivche hashshelamim mikkesef hammaaser. shehashshelamim neechalim lezarim. barishona hayu lokchin behemot leachlan chullin mikkesef maaser sheni kede lehavericham meal hammizbeach. gazru bet din sheen lokchin behema mimmeot maaser ella lishlamim. aval chayya veof lokchin sheenan reuyin lishlamim: 
En lokchin perot sheviit bechesef maaser. lefi shehu chayyav levaer kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Hallokeach mayim umelach o perot mechubbarin o perot sheenan yecholin lehaggia lirushalayim lo kana hammaaser af al pi sheyyatzu hammaot lechullin: 
Hallokeach perot chutz lirushalayim bechesef maaser. beshogeg kofin et hammocher lehachazir haddamim labbealim vehen maaser kemot shehayu. bemezid yaalu happerot veyeachlu birushalayim. veim en mikdash yannichem ad sheyyerakvu: 
Vechen en lokchin behema bechesef maaser chutz lirushalayim. veim lakach beshogeg yachzeru haddamim limkoman. bemezid taale veteachel birushalayim. veim en mikdash tikkaver hi veorah: 
Lakach avadim vekarkaot uvehema temea ben bemezid ben beshogeg im barach hammocher hare ze yeachel keneged otan hammaot birushalayim betorat maaser. ze hakkelal kol shehotzi chutz laachila ushetiyya vesicha middeme maaser uvarach hammocher o met yeachel kenegdo. veim haya hammocher kayyam yachzeru haddamim limkoman. vechen im hevi olot vechattaot vaashamot middeme maaser yochal kenegdan: 
Lakach chayya lezivche shelamim. uvehema livsar taava. hare ze kemi shekkana shor lacharisha velo kana shelamim. lakach behema lishlamim venafal bah mum paka mimmenna kedushshat maaser ufode otah. veen haddamim maaser. veaf al pi chen im pedaah leatzmo mosif chomesh: 
Hammatpis meot maaser lishlamim lo kanu shelamim. shekkedushshat shelamim enah chala al kedushshat maaser. shehammaaser mamon gavoah hu. veen tzarich lomar im hitpis hammaaser atzman lishlamim shello kanu shelamim: 
Haochel maaser sheni betorat chullin afillu bemezid im perot hammaaser atzman achal yatza yede shamayim. veim kesef maaser achal yachzeru damim limkomam veyaalu veyeachlu birushalayim. o yochal kenegdan birushalayim im en yachol lehachazir et haddamim:

Halokeach behema lezivche shelamim vechayya livsar taava mimmi sheeno taggar veeno medakdek yatza haor lechullin. afillu hayu deme haor merubbin al deme habbasar. aval hallokeach min hattaggar lo yatza haor lechullin: 
Vechen hallokeach kadde yayin setumot mimmakom sheddarkam lehimmacher setumot mimmi sheeno taggar yatza hakkankan lechullin. lefichach tzarich hammocher liftoach rashe hakkaddim kede shello yetze hakkankan lechullin. veim ratza lehachamir al atzmo velimkor bemidda yatza hakkankan lechullin: 
Lekachan petuchot o setumot bemakom sheddarkan lehimmacher petuchot. o shellakach min hattaggar shemmedakdek bimchirato lo yatza hakkankan lechullin. lakach salle teenim vaanavim im hakkeli lo yatzu deme hakkeli lechullin: 
Lakach egozim ushekedim vechayyotze bahen yatzu kelippatan lechullin. lakach chotal shel temarim yatza hachotal lechullin. kuppa shel temarim im derusot yatzu hakkuppot lechullin. veim lav lo yatzu lechullin: 
Mi shehaya lo yayin shel maaser sheni vehishil kankannav leoto maaser. af al pi shessatam et pihem lo kana maaser et hakkankannim. kinnes hayyayin letocho setam im kara shem veasahu maaser ad shello satam et pihem lo kana maaser et hakkankannim. veim mishshessatam pihen kara shem veasahu maaser kana maaser et hakkankan. hifkid letoch hakkankan reviit chullin o shekkanas letochan shemen o chometz o tzir o devash shel maaser sheni setam ben mishshessatam ben ad shello satam lo kana maaser et hakkankannim: 
Tzevi shellekacho bechesef maaser umet yikkaver beoro. lekacho chay ushechato venitma hare ze yippade kishar perot shennitmeu. hammanniach dinar maaser sheni lihyot ochel kenegdo ad sheyyetze lechullin vehaya haddinar yotze beesrim maa. achal alav beeser maa vehuzzelu hammaot leachar zeman vahare haddinar yotze bearbaim maa tzarich leechol alav beesrim maa veachar kach yetze lechullin. hukeru hammaot vahare haddinar yotze beeser main ochel alav bechamesh main veachar kach yetze lechullin: 
Hallokeach perot besela shel kesef maaser umashach happerot velo hispik litten hassela ad shehukeru happerot veamdu bishtayim. hare ze mafrish alehen sela bilvad shenneemar venatan (et) hakkesef vekam lo. bintinat hakkesef kone. vehassachar lamaaser: 
Mashach perot bishte selaim velo hispik litten hammaot ad shehuzelu happerot veamdu besela eno mafrish alehen mimmeot maaser sheni ella sela achat. umosif aleha sela sheniyya min hachullin venoten lammocher. veim haya hammocher am haaretz hare ze muttar litten sela sheniyya mimmeot maaser sheni shel demay. natan lo sela shel maaser velo hispik limshoch happerot ad sheamdu bishtayim. ma sheppada pada vehaddin benehen: 
Natan lo selaim shetayim shel maaser velo hispik limshoch happerot ad shechazru lihyot besela ma sheppada pada. umiddat haddin benehem shehammaaser sheni pediyyato hi meshichato: 
Mi shehayu lo perot chullin birushalayim vehayu lo meot maaser sheni chutz lirushalayim omer hare hammaot hahem mechullalin al happerot haellu veyochlem sham betohora veyetzu otan hammaot lechullin bimkoman: 
Hayu lo meot maaser sheni birushalayim veyesh lo perot chutz lirushalayim omer hare hammaot haellu mechullalin al perot hahem veyetzu hammaot lechullin veyaalu happerot veyeachlu birushalayim. sheeno tzarich lihyot hammaot vehapperot bemakom echad bishat hachillul: 
Mi shehayu lo meot maaser birushalayim vetzarich lahem. veyesh lachavero perot chullin sherotze leachlan. omer lachavero hare hammaot haellu mechullalin al perotecha venimtzeu otam happerot lekuchot bechesef maaser veyochal otam chavero betohora. velo hifsid kelum. veyatzu hammaot lechullin: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshehaya chavero baal happerot chaver. sheen mosrin perot shel maaser sheni shel vadday ella lechaver. lefichach im hayu hammaot shel demay omer ken af leam haaretz. umuttar lechallel maaser sheni al perot am haaretz veal meotav veen choshshin lahem shemma shel maaser sheni hem: 
Hammanniach dinar shel maaser lihyot ochel kenegdo veholech kevan sheachal alav ad shello nishar mimmennu (ella) pachot mipperuta yatza lechullin. bamme devarim amurim beshel demay aval beshel vadday lo yetze lechullin ad sheyyishshaer mimmennu pachot mishsheve peruta achar shemmosifin et hachomesh. kegon shennishar mimmennu pachot mearbaa chumshe sheve peruta: 
Temein utehorin shehayu ochlin o shotin keechad birushalayim. veratzu hattehorin lihyot ochlin maaser sheni shellahem. mannichin sela shel maaser sheni veomer. kol shehattehorim ochlim veshotin sela zo mechullal alav. vetetze hassela lechullin shehare achlu veshatu beshavyah betohora. uvilvad shello yiggeu hattemeim bamaachol shello yetammeuhu:

Neta revai hare hu kodesh. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 24)</small> "uvashshana harviit yihye kol piryo kodesh hillulim laAdonai". vedino leheachel birushalayim livalav kemaaser sheni. ucheshem sheen maaser sheni besureya kach en neta revai besureya. uveneta revai hu omer <small>(Bamidbar 5 10)</small> "veish et kodashav lo yihyu" sheen lecha kodesh shello nitparesh dino battora lemi shehu chutz minneta revai: 
Harotze lifdot neta revai podehu kemaaser sheni. veim padahu leatzmo mosif chomesh. veen podin oto ad sheyyaggiu leonat hammaaser shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 25)</small> "lehosif lachem tevuato" ad sheyyaase tevua. veen podin oto bimchubbar kemaaser sheni vahare hu mamon gavoah kemaaser. lefichach eno nikne bemattana ella im netano boser. vedino bishar haddevarim leinyan achila ushetiyya ufediyya kemaaser: 
Vehappode kerem revai ratza podehu anavim ratza podehu yayin. vechen hazzetim. aval shear happerot en meshannin otan mibberiyyatan: 
Kerem revai en lo lo shichcha velo pea velo peret velo olelot. veen mafrishin mimmennu teruma umaasrot keshem sheen mafrishin mimmaaser sheni. ella kullo ole lirushalayim o nifde veyaalu haddamim veyeachlu birushalayim kemaaser: 
Anavim shel kerem revai hitkinu bet din sheyyihyu olin lirushalayim mahalach yom lechol tzad kede leatter shuke yerushalayim beferot. umishecharav bet hammikdash nifde afillu samuch lachoma. ushear kol happerot afillu bizman bet hammikdash nifdin samuch lachoma: 
Ketzad podin neta revai. meniach et hassal al pi shelosha veomdin kamma adam rotze lifdot lo bassela al menat sheyyotzi yetziot hashshomrim vehachamarim vehappoalim mibbeto. veachar shekkotzvin et hashshaar manniach et hammaot veomer kol hannilkat mizze mechullal al hammaot ellu mishshaar kach vechach sallim besela. uvashsheviit podehu beshavyo sheen sham lo shomrim velo poalim. veim haya hefker en lo ella sechar lekita bilvad: 
Mi shehaya lo neta revai bishnat hashshemitta sheyyad hakkol shava tzarich letzayyeno bekozazot adama kede sheyyakkiru bo. velo yochlu mimmennu ad sheyyippadu. veim haya betoch shene arla metzayyenin oto bacharasim kede sheyyifreshu mimmennu. sheim tziyyenu bekozazot adama shemma yitparru. sheissur arla chamur hu shehi asura bahanaya. vehatztzenuin hayu mannichin et hammaot bishnat shemitta veomrin kol hannilkat mipperot revai ellu mechullal al hammaot haellu shehare i efshar lifdoto bimchubbar kemo shebbearnu: 
Beechad betishre rosh hashshana learla velirvai. umeematay monin lahem mishsheat netia. veeno mone merosh hashshana lerosh hashshana ella sheloshim yom beshana chashuvin shana. vehu shettiklot hannetia kodem sheloshim yom. vechamma hu setam hakkelita lechol hailanot shete shabbatot: 
Nimtzet lamed shehannotea 44 yom kodem rosh hashshana alta lo shana. veaf al pi chen en perot hannetia hazzot muttarot bearla ella birviit ad 15 bishvat shehu rosh hashshana lailanot: 
Ketzad. hannotea ilan maachol betv beav mishshana asirit bayyovel. hare hu betoch shene arla ad 15 bishvat mishshenat 13. vechol ma sheyyotzi hailan betoch zeman ze hare hu arla af al pi shennigmeru leachar kamma yamim. umitv bishvat mishshenat 13 beyovel ad 15 bishvat mishshenat 14 hu neta revai. vechol ma sheyyotzi betoch zeman ze hare hu revai vetzarich pidyon. veim nitabbera hashshana nitabbera laarla o larvai: 
Nitan beshishsha asar beav mishshenat eser lo alta lo shenat eser ella hare hu arla shenat 11 veyv veyg kullah. vahare hu neta revai merosh hashshana shel shenat 14 ad sofah: 
Nata hannetia merosh chodesh tishre ad 15 bishvat mone lah shalosh shanim miyyom leyom learla umiyyom leyom lirvai. veraiti laggeonim devarim becheshbon arla urevai en rauy lehaarich ulehashiv alehen uvevadday taut sofrim hem vehaemet kevar bearnu darkah: 
Healin vehallulavin ume gefanim vehassemadar muttarin bearla uvirvai. vehaanavim shesserafam hakkadim vehifsidan vehachartzannim vehazzaggin vehattemed shellahen ukelippe rimmon vehannetz shello ukelippe egozim vehaggarinim asurin bearla umuttarin birvai. vehannovlot kullan asurot:
Kol shehu chayyav bearla yesh lo revai. vechol sheppatur min haarla eno chayyav birvai shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 23)</small> "shalosh shanim yihye lachem arelim" vegomer uvashshana harviit:

Hannotea ilan maachol vedato alav sheyyihye seyag lagginna. o shennetao lekorot lo leferot. hare ze patur min haarla. netao lisyag vechazar vechashav alav lemaachol o shennetao lemaachol vechazar vechashav alav lisyag. kevan sheerev bo machshevet chiyyuv chayyav. netao shalosh shanim lisyag umikkan veelach lemaachol en lo revai. shekkol sheen lo arla en lo revai:

Nata ilan vechashav sheyyihye hatztzad happenimi shello lemaachol vehachitzon lisyag. o sheyyihye hatztzad hattachton lemaachol vehaelyon lisyag. ze shechashav alav lemaachol chayyav baarla. veze shechashav alav lisyag o leetzim patur. shehaddavar taluy bedato shel notea. vehatztzalaf chayyav bearla haevyonot bilvad aval hakkafrisin muttarot:
Hannotea larabbim betoch sadehu chayyav bearla shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 23)</small> "unetatem" afillu larabbim. bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael. aval bechutza laaretz patur:
Hannotea birshut harabbim o bisfina. vehaole meelav birshut hayyachid. veakkum shennata ben leyisrael ben leatzmo. vehaggazlan shennata. chayyavin baarla uvirvai:

Haole meelav bimkom terashim patur. afillu hannotea bemakom sheeno yishshuv patur. vehu shello yihye ose kede tippul shemmetappel beferotav ad shemmevian layyishshuv. aval im haya ose kede tippulo chayyav bearla:
Hannotea lemitzva kegon shennata etrog lelulav o zayit lammenora chayyav baarla. hikdish veachar kach nata patur min haarla. nata veachar kach hikdish chayyav bearla:
Hannotea beatzitz sheeno nakuv chayyav bearla. af al pi sheeno keeretz lizraim hare hu keeretz leilanot:

Ilan shennetao betoch habbayit chayyav bearla. ze shennetao akkum ad shello bau avotenu laaretz patur. aval mishshebbau laaretz af ma shennatu akkum chayyav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 23)</small> "ki tavou el haaretz unetatem". mishsheat bia:
Akkum shehirkiv ilan maachol al gabbe ilan serak chayyav bearla. veyesh laakkum neta revai. sheim ba linhog bemitzva zo hare hu kodesh keneta revai shel yisrael:

Echad hannotea garina o yichur min hailan o sheakar et kol hailan mimmekomo unetao bemakom acher hare ze chayyav bearla. umone mishsheat netiato. zizeo velo akaro veachar kach mille sevivotav beafar. im yachol lichyot illu lo mille sevivotav hare ze patur. veim lav hare ze kemo sheakar venata vechayyav:

Vechen ilan shenneekar venishar mimmennu shoresh echad. afillu kemachat shemmelappefin alav harokmin et hashshani vehechziro limkomo venata patur. mippene sheyyachol lichyot. neekar kullo veneekra hassela sheshsharashav bah immo vechazar unetao kema shehu bechol haadama shessevivot sharashav. im haya yachol lichyot meotah adama illu lo nata hare hu kemi shello neekar. veim lav chayyav:
Ilan shekkitztzetzo meim haaretz vehechlif chayyav bearla umonin lo mishsheat ketzitza:

Echad hannotea veechad hammavrich veechad hammarkiv chayyav. bamme devarim amurim beshechatach bad echad min hailan vehivricho baaretz o hirkivo beilan acher. aval im matach bad echad min hailan hazzaken vehivrich baaretz o hirkivo beilan acher veikkar habbad meore bailan hazzaken hare ze patur:

Gadal ze hayyeled shehivrich veasa perot. veachar kach pasak ikkaro shehu meore bailan hazzaken. mone mishshaa shennifsak. veotan happerot muttarin mippene sheggadlu behetter. veim hinnichan achar shennifsak haikkar ad shehosifu bematayim hare ellu asurin:
Yalda shessibbecha bizkena vehayu perot bayyalda afillu hosifu matayim hare ellu happerot shel yalda asurin. sheen giddule hetter maalin et haikkar haasur:

Ilan shehivrich mimmennu bad baaretz veachar kach neekar hailan kullo vahare hu chay min habbad shehivrich baaretz naasa oto ilan keillu atta nitta vechayyav bearla. umone lailan ulema shetztzamach min hahavracha mishshaa shenneekar:

Hare shehivrich bad baaretz vetzamach. vehivrich bad echad mimma shetztzamach baaretz vetzamach. vechazar vehivrich min hashshelishi afillu hen [mea] meorin ze baze hoil velo nifseku min haikkar harishon hakkol muttar. veim nifsak ikkar harishon mone lakkol mishshaa shennifsak:

Ilan hayyotze min haggeza patur min haarla. min hashsharashim chayyav. yalda pechuta mittefach chayyevet bearla kol shenoteha mippene shenniret kintia bat shenatah. bamme devarim amurim bintia achat o shetayim keneged shetayim veachat yotza zanav. aval im haya hakkerem kullo pachot mittefach hare ze yesh lo kol umonin kederech shemmonin lishar hailanot:

Notin yichur shel arla veen notin egoz shel arla mippene shehu peri. uferot arla asurin bahanaa kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure maachalot. veim avar venata egoz shel arla hare hatztzomeach muttar kishar hailanot:

Vechen en markivin kafniyyot shel arla bidkalim mippene shehen kifri. avar vehirkiv muttar shekkol davar sheyyesh lo shene gormin echad asur veechad muttar hare ze hannigram mishshenehem muttar. lefichach hatztzomeach mipperot arla muttar shehare gorem litzmoach happeri haasur vehaaretz hammutteret:
Mitzvat ase lehitvaddot lifnoy Adonai achar shemmotziin kol hammattanot shebbezera haaretz vezehu hannikra vidduy maaser:

Veen mitvaddin vidduy ze ella achar hashshana shemmafrishin bah maasar ani shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 12)</small> "ki techalle laser" <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha biarti hakkodesh min habbayit":

Ematay mitvaddin. bemincha beyom tov haacharon shel pesach shel reviit veshel sheviit. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 12)</small> "ki techalle laser". beregel shekkol hammaasrot kalim bo. veen happesach maggia mishshana reviit ella kol perot shelishit nitasseru ben perot hailan ben perot haaretz:
En mitvaddin ella bayyom. vechol hayyom kasher levidduy hammaaser. uven bifne habbayit uven shello bifne habbayit chayyav levaer ulehitvaddot:

Vidduy ze neemar bechol lashon shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha" bechol lashon sheatta omer. vechol echad veechad omro bifne atzmo. veim ratzu rabbim lehitvaddot keechad mitvaddin:
Umitzvato bammikdash shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "lifne Adonai". veim hitvadda bechol makom yatza:

Eno mitvadde ad shello yishshaer etzlo achat min hammattanot. shekken hu omer bavvidduy <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "biarti hakkodesh min habbayit". veerev yom tov haacharon haya habbiur ulemachar mitvaddin:

Ketzad hu ose. im nishar etzlo teruma uterumat maaser notnah lakkohen. maaser rishon notno lelevi. maasar ani notno laaniyyim. nisharu etzlo perot maaser sheni shel vadday o neta revai o meot pediyyatan hare ze mevaaran umashlich layyam o soref. nishar etzlo maaser sheni shel demay eno chayyav levaaro. nishar etzlo bikkurim hare hen mitbaarin bechol makom:

Bamme devarim amurim shessoref umevaer keshennisharu etzlo perot sheeno yachol leechol kullan kodem sheyyikkanes yom tov. aval im nishar tavshil shel maaser sheni veneta revai eno tzarich levaaro shehattavshil kimvoar. vechen yayin vetavlin hare hen kimvoarin:
Perot shello higgiu leonat hammaasrot bishat habbiur en meakkevin oto lehitvaddot veeno chayyav levaaran:

Mi shehayu perotav rechokin mimmennu vehiggia yom habbiur hare ze kore shem lammattanot umezakke lahen levalehen al gav karka o lemi shezzoche lahen levaalehen umitvadde lemachar. shennetinat hammittaltelin al gabbe karka enah ella mattana sheyyesh bah chizzuk. aval eno yachol lehakenot lahem hammaaser bachalifin mippene shennire kimchira. vehammaasrot vehatterumot vehammattanot neemar bahen netina lo mechira:

Uminnayin sheeno yachol lehitvaddot ad sheyyotzi kol hammattanot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "biarti hakkodesh min habbayit". hakkodesh ze maaser sheni veneta revai hakkaruy kodesh. min habbayit zo challa shehi hammattana shel kohanim babbayit. netattiv lallevi ze maaser rishon. vegam netattiv mikkelal shekkedamattu mattana acheret vehi teruma gedola uterumat maaser. lagger layyatom velaalmana ze maasar ani veleket shichcha ufea. af al pi sheen leket shichcha ufea meakkevin et havvidduy:

Vetzarich lehaferish hammattanot al hasseder veachar kach yitvadde shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "kechol mitzvatcha asher tzivvitani". ha im hikdim maaser sheni lerishon eno yachol lehitvaddot. nisraf tivlo eno yachol lehitvaddot shehare lo hifrish mattanot velo netanan levaalehen. uvizman shehayu notnin maaser rishon lakkohanim lo hayu mitvaddin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "vegam netattiv lallevi":

Mi sheen lo ella maaser sheni bilvad mitvadde. sheikkar havvidduy bammaaser hu. vechen im lo haya lo ella bikkurim bilvad mitvadde shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "biarti hakkodesh". hakkodesh harishon shehu habbikkurim. aval mi sheen lo ella teruma bifne atzmah eno mitvadde sheen hatteruma teuna vidduy ella bichlal shear hammattanot:

<small>(Devarim 26 13)</small> "lo avarti mimmitzvotecha" shello hifrish mimmin al sheeno mino. velo min hattalush al hamechubbar. velo min hamechubbar al hattalush. velo min hechadash al hayyashan. velo min hayyashan al hechadash. velo shachachti shello shachach millevarcho umillehazkir shemo alav. lo achalti veoni mimmennu ha im achalo baanino eno mitvadde. velo viarti mimmennu betame ha im hifrisho betuma eno mitvadde. velo natatti mimmennu lemet shello lakach mimmennu aron vetachrichin velo netano leonnim acherim. shamati bekol Adonai elohay shehevio levet habbechira. asiti kechol asher tzivvitani shessamach vesimmeach bo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 11)</small> "vesamachta vechol hattov":

<small>(Devarim 26 15)</small> "hashekifa mimmeon kadshecha min hashshamayim" ad <small>(Devarim 26 15)</small> "kaasher nishbata laavotenu eretz zavat chalav udevash" zo bakkasha sheyyitten taam bapperot:

Yisrael umamzerim mitvaddim. aval lo gerim vaavadim meshuchrarim mippene sheen lahem chelek baaretz vahare hu omer <small>(Devarim 26 15)</small> "veet haadama asher natatta lanu". kohanim uleviyyim mitvaddim sheaf al pi shello natlu chelek baaretz yesh lahem are migrash: seliku lehu hilchot maaser sheni veneta revai besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Service on the Day of Ato: Veyom hatztzom makrivin tamid bashshachar vetamid ben haarbayim keseder kol yom veyom. umakrivin musaf hayyom par veayil veshiva kevasim kullam olot. vesair chattat naase bachutz vehu neechol laerev. veod makrivin yeter al musaf ze. par ben bakar lechattat vehu nisraf. veayil leola. ushenehem mishshel kohen gadol. veayil habba mishshel tzibbur haamur befarashat <small>(Vayikra 16 1)</small> "achare mot". vehu haayil haamur bechummash happekudim bichlal hammusaf. vehu hannikra el haam. veod meviin mishshel tzibbur shene seire izzim. echad karev chattat vehu nisraf. vehashsheni sair hammishtalleach. nimtzeu kol habbehemot hakkerevim beyom ze chamesh esre. shene temidin. ufar. ushene elim veshiva kevasim kullam olot. ushene seirim chattat echad naase bachutz veneechal laerev vehashsheni naase bifnim venisraf. ufar kohen gadol lechattat vehu nisraf:

Avodat kol chamesh esre behemot ellu hakkerevin beyom ze enah ella bechohen gadol bilvad. echad kohen hammashuach beshemen hammishcha o hamerubbe bivgadim. veim hayta shabbat af musaf shabbat en makriv oto ella kohen gadol. vechen shear haavodot shel yom ze kegon haketarat hakketoret shel kol yom vahatavat hannerot hakkol asuy bechohen gadol nasuy shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 6)</small> <small>(Vayikra 16 11)</small> <small>(Vayikra 16 17)</small> "vechipper baado uvead beto". beto zo ishto:

Shivat yamim kodem leyom hakkippurim mafrishin kohen gadol mibbeto lelishkato shebbammikdash vedavar ze kabbala mimmoshe rabbenu. umafrishin oto meishto kol shivat yamim ellu shemma timmatze ishto nidda venimtza tame shivat yamim veeno yachol laavod. umatkinin lo kohen gadol acher sheim yeera beze pissul yaavod haacher tachtav. ben sheera bo pissul kodem tamid shel shachar ben sheera bo pissul achar shehikriv karbano ze shennichnas tachtav eno tzarich chinnuch ella avodato mechannachto umatchil meavoda sheppasak bah harishon. avar yom hakkippurim hare harishon chozer laavodato vehashsheni over vechol mitzvot kehunna gedola alav ella sheeno oved kechohen gadol veim avad avodato keshera. veim met harishon ze hashsheni mitmanne tachtav:

Beshivat yamim ellu mazzin alav meefer happara bashshelishi lehaferashato uvashshevii shehu erev yom hakkippurim shemma nitma bemet velo yada. veim chal yom shabbat bashshelishi o bashshevii shello dochin et hahazzaya:

Kol shivat hayyamim margilin oto baavodot. zorek et haddam umaktir et hakketoret umetiv et hannerot umaktir evre tamid al hammizbeach kede sheyyihye ragil baavoda beyom hakkippurim. umosrin lo zekenim mizzikne bet din vekorim lefanav umelammedin oto avodat hayyom vesiddurah veomrin lo ishi kohen gadol kera atta beficha shemma shachachta o shemma lo lamadta davar ze. veerev yom hakkippurim beshacharit hayu maamidin oto beshaare hammizrach umaavirin lefanav parim veelim uchevasim kede sheyyihye makkir veragil baavoda:

Kol shivat hayyamim lo hayu monin mimmennu maachol umashke. erev yom hakkippurim im chashecha lo hayu mannichin oto leechol harebe shehammaachol mevi et hashshena. velo hayu mannichin oto lishon shemma yire keri. velo hayu maachilin oto devarim hammargilin leshichvat zera kegon betzim vechalav cham vechayyotze bahen:

Bime bayit sheni tzatz hamminut beyisrael. veyatzu hatztzedokin mehera yovedu sheenan maaminin battora shebbeal pe. vehayu omrin shekketoret shel yom hakkippurim mannichin otah al haesh bahechol chutz lapparochet uchesheyyaale ashanah machnis otah lefanim lekodesh hakkadashim. hattaam. ze shekkatuv battora <small>(Vayikra 16 2)</small> "ki beanan erae al hakkapporet" amru ki hu anan hakketoret. umippi hashshemua lamdu chachamim sheen noten hakketoret ella bekodesh hakkadashim lifne haaron. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 13)</small> "venatan hakketoret al haesh lifne Adonai". ulefi shehayu choshshin bevayit sheni shemma kohen gadol ze note letzad minut. hayu mashbiin oto erev yom hakkippurim veomrim lo ishi kohen gadol anu sheluche bet din veatta sheluchenu usheliach bet din. mashbiin anu alecha bemi sheshshikken et shemo babbayit hazze shello teshanne davar sheamarnu lecha. vehu poresh uvoche al shechashaduhu beminut. vehen porshin uvochin lefi shechashdu lemi shemmaasav setumin shemma en belibbo kelum:

Kol lele yom hakkippurim kohen gadol yoshev vedoresh im haya chacham. veim haya talmid dorshim lefanav. im haya ragil likro kore veim lav korin lefanav. kede shello yishan. uvamme korin lefanav. bechitve hakkodesh. bikkesh lehitnamnem pirche leviyya makkin lefanav beetzba tzereda. veomrim lo ishi kohen gadol amod vehitztannen meat al haritzpa kede shello tishan. umitassekin immo ad shemmaggia zeman shechita. velo hayu shochatin ad shemmakkirin sheala ammud hashshachar bevadday shemma yishchatu ballayla:

Kol maase hattemidin vehammusafin shel yom ze kohen gadol ose otan vehu lavush bevigde zahav. vaavodot hameyuchadot leyom ze bevigde lavan. vaavoda hameyuchedet leyom ze hi maase happar shel kohen gadol. ushene hasseirim sheechad mehen sair hammishtalleach. vehaketarat hakketoret bekodesh hakkadashim. kol ellu bevigde lavan hem naasim:

Kol et sheyyeshanne habbegadim veyifshot begadim velovesh begadim acherim taun tevila. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 23)</small> "ufashat et bigde habbad" <small>(Vayikra 16 24)</small> "verachatz et besaro vammayim bemakom kadosh velavash et begadav". vechamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin tovel kohen gadol umekaddesh bo bayyom. ketzad. battechilla poshet bigde chol shealav vetovel veole umistappeg velovesh bigde zahav umekaddesh yadav veraglav. veshochet et hattamid umaktir ketoret shel shachar shel kol yom umetiv et hannerot umaktir evre hattamid im hachavitin vehannesachim umakriv happar veshiva kevasim shel musaf hayyom. veachar kach mekaddesh yadav veraglav ufoshet bigde hazzahav vetovel veole umistappeg velovesh bigde lavan. umekaddesh yadav veraglav veoved avodat hayyom kol havvidduyyim im hahagrala uzerikat haddamim bifnim vehaketarat hakketoret bekodesh hakkadashim. umoser hassair lamshallecho laazazel. umotzi emure happar vehassair hannisrafim umoser sheeran lisrefa. veachar kach mekaddesh yadav veraglav ufoshet bigde lavan vetovel veole umistappeg. velovesh bigde zahav umekaddesh yadav veraglav. umakriv seir chattat shel musaf hayyom veelo veel haam. vehem olot. umaktir emure par vesair hannisrafin. umakriv tamid shel ben haarbayim. veachar kach mekaddesh yadav veraglav ufoshet bigde zahav. vetovel veole umistappeg velovesh bigde lavan. umekaddesh yadav veraglav. venichnas lekodesh hakkadashim. umotzi mishsham et hakkaf veet hammachta. veachar kach mekaddesh yadav veraglav ufoshet bigde lavan. vetovel veole umistappeg. velovesh bigde zahav umekaddesh yadav veraglav. umaktir ketoret shel ben haarbayim shel kol yom umetiv et hannerot ben haarbayim. umekaddesh yadav veraglav. ufoshet bigde zahav velovesh bigde chol veyotze:

Kol hattevilot haellu vehakkiddushin kullan bammikdash shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 24)</small> "verachatz et besaro vammayim bemakom kadosh". chutz mittevila rishona shehu rashshay litbol otah bechol sheenah ella lehosif kavvanato. sheim yizkor tuma yeshana shebbeyado yifrosh mimmenna bitvila zo lishmah. vechol kohen shello taval ben begadim livgadim o shello kiddesh ben beged leveged uven avoda laavoda veavad. avodato keshera:

Haya kohen gadol zaken o chole melabbenin ashashiyyot shel barzel beesh mibbaerev ulemachar metilin otan bemayim kede lehafig tzinnatan sheen shevut bammikdash. o mearvin mayim chammin beme hammikve ad shettafig tzinnatan:

Bechol yom kohen gadol mekaddesh yadav veraglav min hakkiyyor kishar hakkohanim vehayyom mekaddesh mikkiton shel zahav mishshum kevodo. bechol yom hakkohanim olim bemizracho shel kevesh veyordin bemaaravo vehayyom olim baemtza veyordin baemtza lifne kohen gadol kede lehaddero. bechol yom mi shezzacha bammachta chote bemachta shel kesef umeare haesh lemachta shel zahav vehayyom chote kohen gadol bemachta shel zahav uvah nichnas lahechol. shello leyaggeo betosefet avoda. vechen machta shel kol yom machzeket arbaa kabbin veshel hayyom shelosha kabbin uvechol yom hayta keveda vehayyom kalla. uvechol yom yadah ketzara vehayyom arukka kede lehakel al kohen gadol shello yiga. bechol yom veyom hayu al hammizbeach shalosh maarachot shel esh vehayyom hayu sham arba. mosifin maaracha kede lehadder hammizbeach uleattero:

Ze shenneemar battora <small>(Vayikra 16 17)</small> "vechipper baado uvead beto uvead kol kehal yisrael". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze vidduy devarim. nimtzeta lamed shehu mitvadde beyom ze shelosha vidduyim. echad al yede atzmo techilla. vidduy sheni al yede atzmo im shear hakkohanim. ushenehem al par hachattat asher lo. vehavvidduy shelishi al yede kol yisrael al sair hammishtalleach. umazkir et hashshem bechol vidduy mehen shalosh peamim. ketzad hu omer. anna hashshem chatati aviti ufashati lefanecha anna hashshem kapper na lachataim velaavonot velappeshaim shechatati vesheaviti vesheppashati vechulei shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 30)</small> "ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu". hare shalosh peamim hizkir et hashshem. vechen bechol vidduy mehen. ucheshehu noten et haggoral al seir hachattat omer lahashshem chattat. nimtza mazkir et hashshem bayyom ze eser peamim. uvechullam hu mazkir kichtavo shehu hashshem hameforash. barishona haya magbiah et kolo bashshem. kevan sherabbu perutzin chazru leamro bekol namuch umavlio binimut ad shello yakkiru bo afillu chaverav hakkohanim:

Kol hakkohanim vehaam haomdim baazara keshehem shomim et hashshem hameforash yotze mippi kohen gadol bikdushsha uvetohora. hayu korim umishtachavim venoflim al penehem veomrim baruch shem kavod malchuto leolam vaed shenneemar <small>(Devarim 32 3)</small> "ki shem Adonai ekra havu godel lelohenu". uvishloshet havvidduyyim haya mitkavven ligmor et hashshem keneged hamevarchin veomer lahen titharu. vechol hayyom kasher levidduy yom hakkippurim ulevidduy happarim hannisrafim:

Shenne haggoralot echad katuv alav lahashshem veechad katuv alav laazazel. vehem kesherim mikkol davar ben min haetz ben min haeven ben min hammattechet. aval lo yihye echad gadol veechad katan. echad kesef veechad zahav. ella shenehem shavin. veshel etz hayu. uvevayit sheni asu otam shel zahav. umannichin shene haggoralot bichli echad hammachazik shete hayyadayim kede sheyyachnis shete yadav velo yitkavven. ucheli ze chol hu. veshel etz haya vekalpi shemo:
Hechan magril. bemizrach haazara bitzfon hammizbeach. mannichin sham hakkalpi. umaamidin shene hasseirim penehen lammaarav vaachorehem lammizrach. vechohen gadol ba lesham vehassegan mimino verosh bet av missemolo ushene hasseirim lefanav echad limino veechad lismolo:
Taraf bakkalpi veheela shene haggoralot bishte yadav leshem shene hasseirim ufoteach yadav. im shel shem ala bimino hassegan omer ishi kohen gadol hagebeah yemincha. veim bismol ala rosh bet av omer lo ishi kohen gadol hagebeah semolcha. venoten shene haggoralot al shenehem. shel yamin al yamin veshel semol al shel semol. veim lo natan lo ikkev ella shechisser mitzva. shehahannacha mitzva sheenah meakkevet vehahagrala meakkevet af al pi sheenah avoda. lefichach hahannacha keshera bezar vehaalayat haggoralot min hakkalpi pesula bezar:
Vekosher leshon zehorit mishkal shete selaim berosh sair hammishtalleach umaamido keneged bet shillucho velannishchat keneged bet shechitato. veshochet et par hachattat asher lo veet hassair sheala alav haggoral lashshem:
Umachnis daman lahechol umazze middam shenehen bayyom hazze arbaim veshalosh hazzayot. veellu hen. mazze techilla middam happar shemone hazzayot bekodesh hakkadashim ben badde haaron karov lakkapporet betefach shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 14)</small> "velifne hakkapporet yazze" vegomer. umazze sham achat lemala vesheva lematta. mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 14)</small> "sheva peamim" yazze yeter al hazzaya rishona. vechach haya mone. achat. achat veachat achat ushetayim achat veshalosh achat vearba achat vechamesh achat veshesh achat vesheva. velamma mone kacha shemma yishkach veyimne hazzaya rishona mikkelal hashsheva. veachar kach mazze middam hassair ben badde haaron shemone achat lemala vesheva lematta umone kederech shemmone bedam happar. vechozer umazze bahechol al happarochet middam happar shemone. achat lemala vesheva lematta shekkach neemar bedam happar <small>(Vayikra 16 15)</small> "al hakkapporet velifne hakkapporet". umone kederech shemmone bifnim. vechozer umazze middam hassair ken al happarochet shemone hazzayot achat lemala vesheva lematta. shenneemar bedam hassair <small>(Vayikra 16 15)</small> "veasa et damo kaasher asa ledam happar". umone kederech shemmone bifnim. vechol ellu hahazzayot eno mitkavven bahen lehazzot lo lemala velo lematta ella kematzlif. veachar kach mearev shene haddamim dam happar vedam hassair umazze mishshenehem arba hazzayot al arba karnot mizbach hazzahav shebbahechol vesheva hazzayot al emtzao shel mizbeach ze:
Vechol ellu haarbaim veshalosh hazzayot tovel etzbao bedam tevila al kol hazzaya lo sheyyazze shete hazzayot mittevila achat. usheyare haddam shofech al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon:
Veachar kach meshalleach et hassair hachay beyad ish hammuchan leholicho lammidbar. vehakkol kesherim leholicho ella sheasu kohanim gedolim keva velo hayu mannichim et yisrael leholicho. vesukkot hayu osin mirushalayim ad techillat hammidbar. veshovet ish echad o anashim harebe bechol sukka vesukka mehen kede sheyyihyu melavvin oto missukka lesukka. al kol sukka vesukka omrin lo hare mazon vahare mayim. im kashal kocho vetzarich leechol ochel. umeolam lo hutzrach adam lechach. veanshe hassukka haacharona omdin besof hattechum veroin et maasav merachok. ketzad haya ose. cholek lashon shel zehorit shebbekarnav. chetzyo kosher bassela vechetzyo kosher ben shete karnav. vedochafo laachorav vehu mitgalgel veyored. lo haya maggia lachatzi hahar ad shehu naase evarim evarim. uva veyoshev lo tachat sukka haacharona ad shettecheshach. vedarchiyyot hayu osin umenifin besudarin kede sheyyedu shehiggia sair lammidbar. veachar shemmeshalleach et hassair beyad molicho chozer etzel happar vehassair shehizza daman lefanim vekoran umotzi et emurehen venotnam bichli umaktiran al gabbe hammizbeach. umechattech shear besaran chatichot gedolot meorot zo bezo kemin kelia veeno mefarek otan umeshallechan beyad acherim lehotzian levet hasserefa. umenattechin otan sham beoran kemo shebbearnu:
Kevan shehiggia sair lammidbar yatza kohen gadol leezrat hannashim likrot battora. uvizman keriato sorfin happar vehassair bevet haddeshen. lefichach haroe kohen gadol keshehu kore eno roe par vesair hannisrafin. userefatan keshera bezar kemo shebbearnu:
Keria zo enah avoda lefichach im ratza likrot bevigde chol levanim mishshello kore. veim ratza likrot bevigde lavan kore shebbigde kehunna nittenu lehanot bahen shello bishat avoda kemo shebbearnu:
Ketzad hu kore. yoshev beezrat hannashim vechol haam omdin lefanav. vechazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora venotno lerosh hakkeneset verosh hakkeneset notno lassegan vehassegan notno lechohen gadol. vechohen gadol omed umekabbel omed vekore <small>(Vayikra 16 1)</small> "achare mot" v<small>(Vayikra 23 27)</small> "ach beasor" shebbefarashat moadot ad sof hainyan vegolel et hattora umannichah becheko veomer yoter mimma shekkarati lifnechem katuv kan. uveasor shebbechummash happekudim ad sof hainyan kore oto al pe. velamma kore al pe sheen gollin sefer tora betzibbur. velamma lo yikra besefer acher. lefi sheen echad kore bishne sefarim mishshum pegam rishon: 
Beet shekkore mevarech lefaneha uleachareha kederech shemmevarchin bevet hakkeneset. umosif leachareha sheva berachot veellu hen. retze Adonai elohenu vechulei modim anachnu lach vechulei selach lanu avinu ki chatanu vechulei vechotem bah baruch atta Adonai mochel avonot ammo yisrael berachamim. hare shalosh berachot ketiknan. umevarech al hammikdash beracha bifne atzmah yihye inyanah sheyyaamod hammikdash ushechina betocho vechotem bah baruch atta Adonai shochen betziyyon. umevarech al yisrael beracha bifne atzmah inyanah sheyyoshia Adonai et yisrael velo yasur mehen melech vechotem bah baruch atta Adonai habbocher beyisrael. umevarech al hakkohanim beracha bifne atzmah inyanah sheyyirtze hammakom maasehem vaavodatam vivarchem vechotem bah baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hakkohanim. veachar kach omer tefilla utechinna verinna uvakkasha kefi ma shehu ragil vechotem hosha Adonai ammecha yisrael sheammecha yisrael tzerichin lehivvasha baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla:

Seder kol hammaasim shebbeyom ze kach hu. kachatzot hallayla mefisin litrumat haddeshen. umesadderin et hammaaracha umedashshenin et hammizbeach kederech sheosin bechol yom al hasseder shebbearnu ad sheyyaggiu lishchitat hattamid. kesheyyaggiu lishchot et hattamid porsin sadin shel butz ben kohen gadol uven haam. velamma shel butz kede sheyyakkir sheavodat hayyom bevigde butz. ufoshet bigde chol vetovel velovesh bigde zahav umekaddesh yadav veraglav. veshochet betamid rov shenayim umanniach acher ligmor hashshechita. umekabbel haddam vezorko al hammizbeach kemitzvato. veachar kach nichnas lahechol umaktir ketoret shel shachar umetiv et hannerot. umaktir evre hattamid vehachavitin vehannesachim kechol seder hattamid shel kol yom shebbearnu. veachar hattamid makriv happar veshivat hakkevasim shel musaf hayyom. veachar kach mekaddesh yadav veraglav ufoshet bigde zahav. vetovel velovesh bigde lavan umekaddesh yadav veraglav. uva lo etzel paro. ufaro haya omed ben haulam velammizbeach rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav vehakkohen omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav. vesomech shete yadav al rosh happar umitvadde. vechach haya omer anna hashshem chatati aviti pashati lefanecha ani uveti. anna hashshem kapper na lachataim velaavonot velappeshaim shechatati vesheaviti vesheppashati lefanecha ani uveti kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha lemor <small>(Vayikra 16 30)</small> "ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu". veachar kach magril al shene hasseirim. vekosher lashon shel zehorit berosh hammishtalleach umaamido keneged bet shillucho velannishchat keneged bet shechitato. uva lo etzel paro sheniyya vesomech shete yadav al rosho umitvadde vidduy sheni. vechach hu omer anna hashshem chatati aviti pashati lefanecha ani uveti uvene aharon am kedoshecha. anna hashshem kapper na lachataim velaavonot velappeshaim shechatati vesheaviti vesheppashati lefanecha ani uveti uvene aharon am kedoshecha kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha ki vayyom hazze vegomer. veachar kach shochet et happar umekabbel et damo venotno lemi shehu menadnedo shello yikkaresh (umannichah) al haroved harvii shel hechol mibbachutz. venotel et hammachta vechote bah esh meal hammizbeach min hassamuch lammaarav. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 12)</small> "meal hammizbeach millifne Adonai". veyored umannichah al haroved shebbaazara. umotziin lo et hakkaf ucheli male ketoret dakka min haddakka. vechofen mimmenna melo chafnav lo mechukot velo gedushot ella tefufot haggadol lefi gadlo vehakkatan lefi katno venoten letoch hakkaf. kevar bearnu sheholacha bismol poselet bedam hakkadashim ushear haavodot. ulefichach haya min haddin sheyyolich hammachta bismolo vechaf hakketoret bimino. aval mippene koved hammachta veod shehi chamma. eno yachol lesavlah bismolo ad haaron. lefichach notel hammachta bimino vechaf hakketoret bismolo. umehallech bahechol ad shehu maggia lekodesh hakkadashim. matza happarochet perufa nichnas lekodesh hakkadashim ad shehu maggia laaron. higgia laaron noten hammachta ben shene habbaddim uvevayit sheni shello haya aron haya mannichah al even hashshetiyya. veochez sefat hakkaf berashe etzbeotav o beshinnav. umeare hakketoret begudalo letoch chafnav ad shemmachzirah limlo chafnav keshehayta. vezo hi avoda kasha shebbammikdash. vetzover et hakketoret al gabbe haggechalim beyado lefanim bammachta. kede shettihye hakketoret kerova laaron urechoka mippanav shello yikkave. umamtin sham ad sheyyitmalle habbayit ashan veyetze. vehu mehallech achorannit meat meat panav lakkodesh vaachorav lahechol ad sheyyetze min happarochet. umitpallel sham bahechol achar sheyyetze tefilla ketzara shello lehaveit et haam shemma yomru met bahechol. vechach haya mitpallel. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu sheim tihye shana zo shechuna tihye geshuma. velo yasur shevet mibbet yehuda. velo yihyu ammecha bet yisrael tzerichin lefarnasa [1.] veal tikkanes lefanecha tefillat ovre derachim: 
Bishat haketarat hakketoret bekodesh hakkadashim. kol haam porshim min hahechol bilvad veenan porshim mibben haulam velammizbeach. sheen porshim mibben haulam velammizbeach ella bishat haketara bahechol bechol yom uvishat mattan damim bahechol kemo shebbearnu behilchot temidin. veachar kach notel dam happar mizze shehu menadnedo. venichnas bo lekodesh hakkadashim umazze mimmennu sham shemone hazzayot ben badde haaron. veyotze umannicho bahechol al kan hazzahav shehaya sham. veachar kach yotze min hahechol veshochet et hassair umekabbel et damo venichnas bo lekodesh hakkadashim. umazze mimmennu sham shemone hazzayot ben badde haaron. veyotze umannicho al kan hazzahav sheni shebbahechol. veachar kach notel dam happar meal hakkan umazze mimmennu al happarochet keneged haaron shemone hazzayot umanniach dam happar venotel dam hassair umazze mimmennu al happarochet keneged haaron shemone hazzayot. veachar kach meare dam happar letoch dam hassair umachazir hakkol lammizrak shehaya bo dam happar kede sheyyitarvu yafe yafe. veomed lefanim mimmizbach hazzahav ben hammizbeach vehammenora. umatchil lehazzot middam hattaarovet al karnot mizbach hazzahav. vehu mesabbev veholech umazze al hakkeranot mibbachutz. umatchil mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit. litzfonit maaravit. lemaaravit deromit. lidromit mizrachit. veal kullan hu noten millemattan lemalan. chutz min haacharona shehayta lefanav shehu noten millemalan lemattan. kede shello yitlachlechu kelav. vechote haggechalim vehaefer shebbemizbach hazzahav helach vehelach ad shemmegalle zehavo. umazze middam hattaarovet al tohoro shel mizbeach sheva peamim betzad haddarom bemakom sheshshalmu mattenot karnotav. veyotze veshofech sheyare haddam al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon. veachar kach ba etzel sair hammishtalleach vesomech shete yadav al rosho umitvadde. vechach hu omer anna hashshem chatu avu ufashu lefanecha ammecha bet yisrael. anna hashshem kapper na lachataim velaavonot velappeshaim shechatu vesheavu vesheppashu lefanecha ammecha bet yisrael kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha <small>(Vayikra 16 30)</small> "ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem" vegomer. veachar kach meshalleach et hassair lammidbar. umotzi emure par vesair shehichnis daman lefanim venotnan bichli. umeshalleach hashshear levet haddeshen lisrefa. veyotze leezrat hannashim vekore sham achar sheyyaggia hassair lammidbar. veachar kach mekaddesh ufoshet bigde lavan vetovel velovesh bigde zahav umekaddesh yadav veraglav. veose hassair hannaase bachutz shehu mikkelal karbenot musaf hayyom. umakriv elo veel haam shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 24)</small> "veyatza veasa et olato veet olat haam". umaktir haemurin shel par vesair hannisrafin. umakriv tamid shel ben haarbayim. veachar kach mekaddesh yadav veraglav ufoshet bigde zahav vetovel velovesh bigde lavan umekaddesh venichnas lekodesh hakkadashim umotzi et hakkaf veet hammachta. veachar kach mekaddesh ufoshet bigde lavan vetovel velovesh bigde zahav umekaddesh umaktir ketoret shel ben haarbayim umetiv et hannerot shel ben haarbayim kishar hayyamim. veachar kach mekaddesh yadav veraglav ufoshet bigde zahav velovesh bigde atzmo veyotze leveto vechol haam melavvin oto ad beto. veyom tov haya ose al sheyyatza beshalom min hakkodesh:
Kol avodot sheoved bevigde lavan bifnim bahechol tzarich laasotan al hasseder shebbearnu. veim hikdim bahen maase lachavero lo asa kelum:

Ketoret shechafanah kodem shechitat happar lo asa kelum. af al pi shehachafina baazara tzorech penim kaavodat penim hi. vechen sair sheshshechato kodem mattan damo shel par lo asa kelum. af al pi shehashshechita baazara hare damo nichnas lefanim:
El useir hammusafin sheasa otan kodem avodat hayyom enan kelum:

Hikdim dam hassair ledam happar bekodesh hakkadashim kodem sheyyigmor avodato. yazze middam happar kemitzvato veachar kach yavi sair acher veyishchot oto veyazze middamo bekodesh hakkadashim kemitzvato veyippasel harishon. hikdim dam hassair ledam happar bemattanot shebbahechol al happarochet yachzor veyazze middam hassair paam sheniyya leachar dam happar:
Nishpach haddam ad shello gamar mattanot shebbekodesh hakkadashim. yavi dam acher veyachzor veyazze battechilla bekodesh hakkadashim:
Gamar mattanot shebbekodesh hakkadashim vehitchil bemattanot shebbahechol venishpach haddam ad shello gamar yavi dam acher veyatchil mittechillat hazzayot shebbahechol:
Gamar mattanot shebbahechol vehitchil litten al mizbach hazzahav venishpach haddam ad shello gamar. yavi dam acher umatchil mittechillat mattenot hammizbeach shekkullan kappara bifne atzman hen:

Gamar mattenot hammizbeach veachar kach nishpach haddam eno tzarich lehavi dam acher. sheshshefichat hashsheyarim al mizbeach hachitzon enah meakkevet. veim dam happar hu shennishpach kodem sheyyigmor kol hammattanot hare ze mevi par acher. veyachafon ketoret paam sheniyya kodem shechitat happar. veyaktir hakketoret veachar kach yavi damo veyazze mimmennu:
Veen metamme begadim veen nisraf bevet haddeshen ella happar hazze haacharon shebbo nigmera hakkappara:

Nitarev lo dam happar bedam hassair kodem sheyyigmor hahazzayot. noten achat lemala vesheva lematta leshem par. vechozer venoten achat lemala vesheva lematta leshem sair. nitarvu bemattana acharona. noten achat lematta leshem par vechozer venoten achat lemala vesheva lematta leshem sair:

Nitchallefu hakkosot velo yada e ze hu kos dam happar vee ze hu kos dam hassair noten meechad mehen achat lemala vesheva lematta. venoten min hashsheni achat lemala vesheva lematta. (vechozer venoten min harishon achat lemala vesheva lematta). nimtza mikkol makom shennatan middam happar veacharav middam hassair:

Kibbel dam happar bishte kosot. vekibbel dam hassair bishte kosot. venitarvu miktzat hakkosot. velo noda kos dam happar mikkos dam hassair. hare ze mazze kol hahazzayot kemitzvatan min hakkosot shello nitarvu. veshofach sheyare ellu shehizza mehen al hayesod kammitzva. veotan hakkosot shennitarvu yishshafchu laamma:

Par yom hakkippurim af al pi shekkohen gadol kone mishshello shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 6)</small> <small>(Vayikra 16 11)</small> "par hachattat asher lo". hammakom hifkir mamono bo lechol echav hakkohanim. sheillu lo haya lahen bo shuttafut lo hayu mitkapperin bo. lefichach im met kohen gadol kodem sheyyishshachet happar. hakkohen sheomed tachtav eno mevi par acher ella shochet et shel rishon. veeno chattat shemmetu bealeha shettamut sheen chattat harabbim meta. shachat et happar umet kodem sheyyechapper bedamo. hakkohen haacher nichnas bedam ze umechapper bo:
Shene seire yom hakkippurim mitzvatan sheyyihyu shavin bemare uvekoma uvedamim. ulekichatan keachat. af al pi sheenan shavin kesherin. lakach echad mehen hayyom veechad lemachar kesherim:

Met echad mehen. im ad shello higril met yikkach zug lesheni. veim mishshehigril met yavi shenayim veyagril alehen battechilla veroe e zehu shemmet. im haya shel shem omer ze sheala alav haggoral lashshem yitkayyem tachtav. veim haya hammet shel azazel yomar ze sheala alav haggoral laazazel yitkayyem tachtav. vehashsheni min hashshenayim shehigril alehen bassof yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava. sheen chattat hatztzibbur meta:

Par vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen vekarvu venimtzeu harishonim. yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava. vechen im nimtzeu harishonim kodem sheyyikkarvu ellu yikkarvu harishonim veyiru hashsheniyyim ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyippelu demehen lindava. sheen chattat hatztzibbur meta:
Hammum posel besair hammishtalleach afillu mum over. vechen im naasa mechussar zeman nifsal. kegon shennishchata immo lechole beyom hakkippurim. sheddechiyyato laazazel hi shechitato:
Haya terefa pasul shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 10)</small> "yoomad chay":
Chala hassair veen yachol lehallech markivo al ketefo vaafillu beshabbat:
Chala hameshalleach hare ze meshallecho beyad acher:
Nitma hameshalleach hare ze nichnas lammikdash venotlo veyotze. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 21)</small> "beyad ish itti hammidbara". beyad ze shehuchan afillu nitma:
Dechafo venafal hassair velo met. yered acharav vimitennu bechol davar shemmemito. veevre sair ze muttarin bahanaya:
Nifchata tikra shel hechol lo haya mazze. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 17)</small> "beohel moed":
Mizbeach shello nitchannech bakketoret lo yazze alav. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 7)</small> "mizbach ketoret hassammim":

Chisser min hakketoret echad missammaneha o maale ashan chayyav mita aleha shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 2)</small> "velo yamut ki beanan erae al hakkapporet". vechen chayyav mita al biato belo mitzva. lefichach im shagag bevia vehezid biktoret. o shennichnas biktoret shelema im hachasera chayyav mita:
Hiktir min hakketoret shel kodesh hakkadashim kezayit bahechol chayyav mita:
Chafinat hakketoret avoda. vehammachshava poselet bah. vechen chatiyyat haggechalim lakketoret nifselet bemachshava. shemmachshire karban kekarban:

Chafan berashe etzbeotav o min hatztzedadin o mimmatta lemala o shechafan beyado zo uveyado zo vekarav zo lazo. o shennitpazzera ketoret miyyado al haaretz vaasafah. o shechafan chavero venatan lechafnav. o shechafan umet venichnas sheni bema shechafan rishon. kol ellu safek velo yaktir veim hiktir hurtza:
Mishneh Torah, Sheqel Dues 1:
Mitzvat ase min hattora litten kol ish miyyisrael machatzit hashshekel bechol shana veshana. afillu ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka chayyav. veshoel meacherim o mocher kesut sheal ketefo venoten machatzit hashshekel kesef shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 15)</small> "heashir lo yarbe vehaddal lo yamit" vegomer. veeno notno bifamim rabbot hayyom meat ulemachar meat ella notno kullo keachat befaam achat: 
Minyan kesef haamur battora beones uvimfatte uvemotzi shem ra vehoreg eved hu kesef hu shekel hanneemar bechol makom battora. umishkalo shelosh meot veesrim seora. uchevar hosifu chachamim alav veasu mishkalo kemishkal hammatbea hannikra sela bizman bayit sheni. vechamma hu mishkal hassela shelosh meot vearba ushemonim seora benonit: 
Hassela arbaa dinarin vehaddinar shesh main. umaa hi hannikret bime moshe rabbenu gera. umaa hi shene punedyonin ufunedyon shene isarin. uferuta achat mishshemona beisar. nimtza mishkal hammaa vehi haggera shesh esre seorot. umishkal haisar arba seorot. umishkal happeruta chatzi seora: 
Veod matbea acher haya sham shehaya mishkalo shete selaim vehu haya nikra darkon. veellu hammatbeot kullan sheamarnu uvearnu mishkal kol echad mehen hen shemmeshaarin bahen bechol makom. uchevar bearnum kede shello ehye tzarich lefaresh mishkalam bechol makom: 
Machatzit hashshekel zo mitzvatah sheyyitten machatzit matbea shel oto hazzeman afillu haya oto matbea gadol mishshekel hakkodesh. uleolam eno shokel pachot mechatzi hashshekel shehaya bime moshe rabbenu shehu mishkalo mea veshishshim seora: 
Bizman shehaya matbea shel oto zeman darkonot haya kol echad veechad noten bemachatzit hashshekel shello sela. uvizman shehaya hammatbea selaim haya noten kol echad bemachatzit hashshekel shello chatzi sela shehu shene dinarin. uvizman shehaya hammatbea chatzi sela haya kol echad veechad noten bemachatzit hashshekel oto chatzi hassela. umeolam lo shaklu yisrael bemachatzit hashshekel pachot mechatzi shekel shel tora: 
Hakkol chayyavin litten machatzit hashshekel kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim vegerim vaavadim meshuchrarim. aval lo nashim velo avadim velo ketannim. veim natnu mekabbelin mehem. aval hakkutim shennatnu machatzit hashshekel en mekabbelin mehem. katan shehitchil aviv litten alav machatzit hashshekel shuv eno posek ella noten alav bechol shana veshana ad sheyyagdil veyitten al atzmo: 
Hashshekalim enan nohagin ella bifne habbayit. uvizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam notnin et hashshekalim ben beeretz yisrael ben bechutza laaretz. uvizman shehu charev afillu beeretz yisrael en nohagin: 
Beechad baadar mashmiin al hashshekalim kede sheyyachin kol echad veechad machatzit hashshekel shello. veyihye atid litten. bachamishsha asar bo yashvu hashshulchanim bechol medina umedina vetovin benachat kol mi sheyyitten lahem yekabbelu mimmennu umi shello natan en kofin oto litten. bachamishsha veesrim bo yashvu bammikdash ligbot. umikkan veelach kofin et mi shello natan ad sheyyitten. vechol mi shello yitten memashkenin oto velokchin avoto baal karcho vaafillu kesuto: 
Kol mi sheeno chayyav bishkalim af al pi sheddarko litten o hu atid litten en memashkenin oto. veen memashkenin et hakkohanim leolam mippene darche shalom ella kesheyyittenu mekabbelin mehen vetovin otan ad sheyyittenu:
Mishneh Torah, Sheqel Dues 2:
Ketzad konsin hashshulchanim et hashshekalim bechol medina umedina. mannichin lifnehem shete tevot shule hatteva rechavin millematta ufiha tzar millemala kemin shofar kede sheyyashlichu letochan velo yihye efshar likkach mehen benachat. velamma osin shete tevot. achat shemmashlichin bah shekalim shel shana zo. vehashsheniyya mannichin bah shikle shana sheavra. sheggovin mimmi shello shakal beshana sheavra: 
Uvammikdash haya lifnehem tamid shelosh esre tevot. kol teva kemin shofar. rishona leshikle shana zo. sheniyya leshikle shana sheavra. shelishit lechol mi sheyyesh alav karban shete torim o shene bene yona echad ola veechad chattat mashlich demehen leteva zo. reviit lechol mi sheyyesh alav olat haof bilvad mashlich dameha leteva zo. chamishit lemi shehitnaddev maot liknot etzim lammaaracha bahen. shishshit lemi shehitnaddev maot lilvona. sheviit lemi shehitnaddev zahav lakkapporet. sheminit lemotar chattat kegon shehifrish maot lechattato velakach chattat vehotir min hammaot yashlich hashshear letochah. teshiit lemotar asham. asirit lemotar kinne zavim vezavot veyoldot. achat esre lemotar karbenot nazir. shetem esre lemotar asham metzora. shelosh esre lemi shehitnaddev maot leolat behema: 
Veshem kol davar sheyyihyu maotav betoch hatteva katuv al hatteva mibbachutz. utenay bet din hu al kol hammotarot sheyyikkarvu olat behema. nimtzeta lamed shekkol hammaot hannimtzaot beshesh hattevot haacharonot leolat behema veoroteha lakkohanim kishar kol haorot. vechol hammaot shebbeteva shelishit likkach bahen ofot chetzyan olot vechetzyan chattaot. veshebbarviit kullan olat haof: 
Bechol medina umedina kesheggovin hashshekalim meshallechin otan beyad sheluchim lammikdash. veyesh lahem letzaref otan bedinre zahav mippene massooy hadderech. vehakkol mitkabbetzin lammikdash umannichin otan belishka achat min halleshachot bammikdash vesogrin kol daltoteha bemaftechot vechotmin aleha chotamot umemallein mikkol hashshekalim sheyyitkabbetzu sham shalosh kuppot gedolot shiur kol kuppa kede shettachil tesha sein vehashshear mannichin oto ballishka. veze shebbetoch hakkuppot hu hannikra terumat hallishka veze sheyyishshaer sham yeter al ma sheyyesh bakkuppot hu hannikra sheyare hallishka: 
Bishlosha perakim bashshana tormin et hallishka. berosh chodesh nisan. uverosh chodesh tishre kodem yom tov o acharav. vekodem atzeret bachamishsha asar yom. vechetzad tormin otah. echad nichnas lifnim min hallishka vehashshomrin omdim bachutz vehu omer lahem etrom vehen omrim lo terom terom terom shelosha peamim. veachar kach memalle shalosh kuppot ketannot kol kuppa mehen mechila shalosh sein meotan shalosh kuppot haggedolot umotzian lachutz kede lehistappek mehen ad sheyyichlu. vechozer umemalle otan hashshalosh kuppot hakketannot min shalosh gedolot paam sheniyya kodem atzeret umistappekin mehen ad sheyyichlu: 
Vechozer umemalle otan paam shelishit min hashshalosh kuppot haggedolot betishre umistappekin mehen ad sheyyichlu ad rosh chodesh nisan. uverosh chodesh nisan tormin mitteruma chadasha. lo hispiku lahen hashshekalim shebbeshalosh kuppot haggedolot vechalu ad shello higgia nisan chozrin vetormin mishsheyare hallishka: 
Shalosh kuppot hakketannot shehu torem bahem umotzian lachutz katuv alehen alef bet gimel kede sheyyistappeku min harishona ad shettichle. veachar kach mistappekin min hashsheniyya. veachar kach mistappekin min hashshelishit. vetorem rishona min hakkuppa haachat haggedola umechappe otah haggedola bemitpachat. vetorem hashsheniyya mehakkuppa haggedola hashsheniyya umechappe otah haggedola bemitpachat. vetorem hashshelishit min hakkuppa haggedola hashshelishit veeno mechappe otah bemitpachat kede shettihye nikkeret shebbah siyyem. veyatchil mimmenna battechilla befaam sheniyya kesheyyikkanes kodem atzeret. vetorem harishona min haggedola shehayta megulla umechappe otah. vetorem hashsheniyya min haggedola shettaram mimmenna barishona techilla umechappe otah. vetorem hashshelishit min haggedola hassemucha lah veeno mechappe otah kede sheyyatchil mimmenna battechilla befaam shelishit kesheyyikkanes betishre. ad shennimtza torem rishona usheniyya ushelishit hakketannot mikkol achat veachat min haggedolot: 
Keshehu torem shalosh kuppot ellu torem et harishona leshem eretz yisrael. vehashsheniyya leshem hakkerakkin hammukkafin lah uleshem kol (eretz) yisrael. vehashshelishit leshem bavel uleshem maday uleshem hammedinot harchokot uleshem shear kol yisrael: 
Keshehu torem mitkavven litrom al haggavuy sheyyesh ballishka. veal haggavuy sheadayin lo higgia lallishka. veal heatid liggavot kede sheyyihyu ellu hashshekalim shehotzian lehistappek mehen kappara al kol yisrael ucheillu higgiu kol shiklehen lallishka venitrema mehen teruma zo: 
Kesheyyikkanes hattorem litrom lo yikkanes beveged sheefshar lehachebot bo kesef velo beminal velo besandal velo bitfilla velo bekamea shemma yachshedu oto haam veyomru hechbi mimmeot hallishka tachtav keshetteramah. umedabberim hayu immo mishshaa sheyyikkanes ad shaa sheyyetze kede shello yitten letoch piv. veaf al pi shennizharim kol kach ani o mi shehu nivhal lahon lo yitrom mippene hachashad shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 32 22)</small> "vihyitem nekiyyim meAdonai umiyyisrael":
Mishneh Torah, Sheqel Dues 3:
Chatzaye hashshekalim hakkol tzerichin lahen kede sheyyitten kol echad veechad chatzi shekel shehu chayyav. lefichach keshehaya adam holech etzel hashshulchani umetzaref shekel bishne chatzain yitten lo tosefet al hashshekel. veotah hattosefet nikret kalbon. lefichach shenayim shennatnu shekel al shenehem chayyavin bekalbon: 
Kol mi sheeno chayyav bishkalim kegon shete nashim o shene avadim shennatnu shekel peturim min hakkalbon. vechen im haya echad chayyav veechad patur venatan hachayyav al yad happetur kegon ish shennatan shekel alav veal ishsha o eved patur min hakkalbon. vechen hakkohanim peturin min hakkalbon vehashshokel al yad hakkohen patur min hakkalbon: 
Hannoten shekel alav veal heani o al shecheno o al ben iro. im netano lahem mattana patur min hakkalbon. shehare natan chatzi shekel mattana kede leharebot bishkalim. veim natan lahem hachatzi sheshshakal al yadam derech halevaa ad sheyyachaziru lo keshettimtza yadam chayyav hakkalbon: 
Haachin sheadayin lo chalku ma shehinniach lahem avihem. vechen hashshuttafim shennatnu shekel al yede shenehem peturin min hakkalbon. bamme devarim amurim beshuttafin shennasu venatnu bimot hashshuttafut venishtanna en hammaot. aval im hevi ze meotav veze meotav veervum vaadayin lo nishtannu hammaot velo hotzium hare ellu chayyavin bekalbon. nasu venatnu veachar zeman chalku vechazru venishtattefu chayyavin bekalbon ad sheyyisseu veyittenu beshuttafut zo haacharona veyishtannu hammaot: 
Haachin vehashshuttafin shehaya lahen behema uchesafim vechalku bakkesafim chayyavim bekalbon. af al pi sheadayin lo chalku habbehema. veim chalku habbehema velo chalku hakkesafim peturin min hakkalbon ad sheyyachleku hakkesafim veen omrin hare hem omdin lachaluka: 
Hannoten shekel lehekdesh kede sheyyechashshevu lo machatzit hashshekel shehu chayyav bah veyittol chatzi shekel mimma shennigba min haacherim chayyav shene kalbonot. sheillu haya hashshekel kullo lishkalim haya chayyav kalbon echad: 
Kamma hu shiur hakkalbon. bizman shehayu notnin bemachatzit hashshekel shene dinarin haya hakkalbon chatzi maa shehu echad mishshenem asar bedinar. umeolam lo nittan hakkalbon pachot mizze. vehakkalbonot enan kishkalim ella mannichin otan hashshulchanim bifne atzman ad sheyyistappek mehen hahekdesh: 
Mi sheavad shiklo chayyav beachrayuto ad sheyyimserennu laggizbar. bene hair sheshshalchu et shiklehen beyad shaliach venignevu o avdu. im shomer chinnam hu hare ze nishba lahem veniftar kedin kol shomre chinnam vehen chozrin venotnin shiklehen paam sheniyya. veim amru anshe hair hoil veanu meshallemin shekalenu en retzonenu sheyyishshava hashshaliach shehu neeman lanu en shomin lahen. lefi shettakkanat chachamim hi sheen hekdesh yotze belo shevua. nimtzeu hashshekalim harishonim achar shennishba hashshaliach ellu veellu shekalim hem veen olin lahen leshana acheret. veharishonim yippelu leshikle hashshana vehaacharonim yippelu leshikle shana sheavra: 
Shalchu et shiklehem beyad shomer sachar shehare hu chayyav bigneva vaaveda veavdu mimmennu beones. kegon shellekachum listim mezuyyanim shehu patur. roin im achar shennitrema hatteruma neenas nishba hashshaliach laggizbarim uvene hair peturin. shehattorem torem al haggavuy veal heatid liggavot uvirshut hekdesh hen uvene hair me haya lahen laasot hare lo masru ella leshomer sachar shehu chayyav bigneva vaaveda. aval haones eno matzuy. veim avdu kodem shennitrema hatteruma adayin birshut bene hair hem vehashshaliach nishba lifne anshe hair vehen meshallemin. nishba vegavu shekalim shenit veachar kach hechezirum hallistim ellu veellu shekalim veen olin lahen leshana acheret vehashsheniyyim yippelu leshikle shana sheavra. yesh mi sheomer shehashshekalim harishonim sheyyippelu leshikle hashshana hem hashshekalim shenniggebu battechilla veavdu o neensu vechazru. veyesh mi sheomer shehashshekalim harishonim hen shehiggiu leyad haggizbar techilla: 
Hannoten chatzi shekel lachavero leholicho leshulchani lishkol oto al yado. halach ushekalo al yede atzmo kede shello yemashkenu oto. im nitrema hatteruma meal hashshokel shezze hashshekel birshut hekdesh hu shekkevar teramo al heatid ligbot venimtza ze hitztzil atzmo bemamon hahekdesh venehena bashshekel hazze. veim lo nitrema hatteruma lo maal vehu chayyav litten lachavero chatzi shekel shennatan lo. vechen haggozel o haggonev chatzi shekel ushekalo yatza vehu chayyav leshallem labbealim shenayim o lehosif chomesh: 
Hannoten machatzit hashshekel min hahekdesh venitrema hatteruma mimmennu. kesheyyistappeku mimmenna yitchayyev bimila veyatza yede machatzit hashshekel. netano mimmeot maaser sheni yochal kenegdo birushalayim. middeme sheviit yochal kenegdo bikdushshat sheviit. haya shel ir hanniddachat lo asa kelum: 
Hammafrish shiklo vesavur shehu chayyav bo venimtza sheeno chayyav lo kaddash. hammafrish shenayim venimtza sheeno chayyav ella echad. im beze achar ze haacharon lo kaddash. veim bevat achat haechad shekalim vehashsheni motar shekalim. hifrish shiklo vamet yippol lindava: 
Hallokeach maot beyado veamar ellu leshikli. o shehaya melakket maa maa o peruta peruta ucheshehitchil lelakket amar hareni melakket maot leshikli. afillu likket melo kis noten mehen chatzi shekel shehu chayyav bo vehashshear chullin shemmotar hashshekalim chullin: 
Maot shennimtzeu ben teva shel shekalim leteva shel nedava. karov lashshekalim yippelu lishkalim. karov lannedava yippelu lindava. mechetza al mechetza yippelu lindava mippene shehannedava kullah ola laishshim vehashshekalim mistappekin mehen leolot velidvarim acherim: 
Vechen kol hammaot hannimtzaim ben kol teva veteva yippelu lakkarov. nimtzeu mechetza lemechetza. im ben etzim lallevona nimtzeu yippelu lallevona. ben kinnim legozale ola yippelu legozale ola. ze hakkelal holchin achar hakkarov bechullan. mechetza lemechetza lehachamir. vechol hammaot hannimtzaot behar habbayit chullin sheen haggizbar motzi maot mitterumat hallishka ad shehu mechallelan al habbehemot shellokeach lekarbanot:
Mishneh Torah, Sheqel Dues 4: Terumat hallishka ma yease bah. lokchin mimmenna temidin shel kol yom vehammusafin vechol karbenot hatztzibbur veniskehem vehammelach shemmolchin bo kol hakkarbanot. vechen haetzim im lo heviu etzim velo nimtzeu ella bedamim. vehakketoret usechar asiyyatah. velechem happanim usechar ose lechem happanim. vehaomer ushete hallechem ufara adumma vesair hammishtalleach velashon shel zehorit shekkoshrin ben karnav. kol ellu bain mitterumat hallishka:
