Aval par helem davar shel tzibbur useire avodat kochavim battechilla govin lahen veenan bain mitterumat hallishka. parochot shel hechol tachat binyan asuyot veenan bain mitterumat hallishka ella mikkadshe bedek habbayit. aval parochot shel shearim bain mitterumat hallishka. hammenora uchele sharet mitzvatan sheyyavou mimmotar hannesachim. uvehilchot kele hammikdash vehaovdim bo yitbaer ma hu motar hannesachim. veim lo haya lahen motar nesachim yaviu mitterumat hallishka. bigde kehunna ben bigde kohen gadol ben shear bigde hakkohanim sheovdin bahen bammikdash hakkol mitterumat hallishka:

Kol habbehemot hannimtzaot birushalayim o bechutza lah bekarov mimmenna baot olot kemo sheyyitbaer bifsule hammukdashin. niskehen bain mitterumat hallishka. vechen oved kochavim sheshshalach olato mimmedina acheret velo shalach immah deme nesachim yaviu niskehem mitterumat hallishka:

Ger shemmet vehinniach zevachim im yesh lo nesachim kerevin mishshello veim lav bain mitterumat hallishka. kohen gadol shemmet velo minnu acher tachtav makrivin et hachavitin mitterumat hallishka. mevakkere mumim shebbirushalayim vetalmide chachamim hamelammedim hilchot shechita lakkohanim vehilchot kemitza venashim hamegaddelot benehen lefara adumma kullan notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka. vechamma hu secharan. kemo sheyyifseku lahen bet din:

Bishnat hashshemitta shehi hefker sochrin bet din shomrin sheyyishmeru miktzat sefichim shetztzamchu kede sheyyaviu mehen haomer ushete hallechem sheen baim ella min hechadash. veellu hashshomrin notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka:

Mi shehitnaddev lishmor bechinnam en shomin lo mishshum baale zeroa shemma yavou veyittelum mehen. lefichach tikkenu lahem chachamim sheyyittelu sachar min hallishka kede sheyyifreshu hakkol meoto makom sheellu shomrim sham:

Maggihe sefarim shebbirushalayim vedayyanin sheddanin et haggazlanin birushalayim notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka. vechamma hayu notlim tishim mane bechol shana. veim lo hispiku lahen af al pi shello ratzu mosifin lahen kede tzarkan hem uneshehem uvenehem uvene betan:

Kevesh hayu bonin mehar habbayit lehar hammishcha shealav motziin para adumma. vechevesh shemmotziin alav sair hammishtalleach. ushenehem naasin mishsheyare hallishka. vechen mizbach haola vehahechol vehaazarot naasin mishsheyare hallishka. ammat hammayim shebbirushalayim vechomat yerushalayim vechol migdeloteha vechol tzarche hair bain mishsheyare hallishka. veoved kochavim shehitnaddev maot laddevarim haellu o laasot immahem bechinnam en mekabbelin mimmennu vaafillu ger toshav. shenneemar <small>(Ezra 4 3)</small> "lo lachem valanu livnot" vegomer veneemar <small>(Nechemya 2 20)</small> "velachem en chelek" vegomer:

Motar terumat hallishka usheyare hallishka lokchin bo zecharim vikarvu kullan olot shettenay bet din hu al kol hammotarot sheyyikrevu olat behema. aval lo olat haof sheen bekarbenot hatztzibbur of. veellu haolot habbain mimmotar hashshekalim hem hannikraim kayitz lammizbeach:
Shekalim shello hispiku lahen lechol karbenot hatztzibbur motziin et harauy lahem mikkadshe bedek habbayit. aval en bedek habbayit motzi et harauy lo mikkadshe hammizbeach:

Mishsheyaggia rosh chodesh nisan en makrivin karbenot tzibbur ella mitteruma chadasha. veim lo baa hachadasha lokchin min hayeshana. lefichach im higgia rosh chodesh nisan veyesh immahen behemot litmidim mitteruma yeshana podin otan veyotzin lechullin af al pi shehen temimin veyippelu demehen litruma yeshana shemmekitzin bah et hammizbeach. shettenay bet din hu al kol habbehemot shellokchin litmidin sheim lo yihyu tzerichin lahen yetzu lechullin:

Vechach hayu osin bemotar hakketoret. mishsheyaggia rosh chodesh nisan mechallelin oto al sechar haummanin vechozrin maot hassachar leketz hammizbeach venotlin haummanin motar hakketoret bischaran vechozrin velokchin et hakketoret mehen mitteruma chadasha kede lehakerivah mimmeot teruma chadasha. veim en lahen teruma chadasha maktirin otah mitteruma yeshana: salik lehu hilchot shekalim
Mishneh Torah, Shofar, Sukkah and Lulav:
Mitzvat ase shel tora lishmoa teruat hashshofar berosh hashshana shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 29 1)</small> "yom terua yihye lachem". veshofar shettokin bo ben berosh hashshana ben beyovel hu keren hakkevasim hakkafuf. vechol hashshofarot pesulin chutz mikkeren hakkeves. veaf al pi shello nitparesh battora terua beshofar berosh hashshana hare hu omer beyovel <small>(Vayikra 25 9)</small> "vehaavarta shofar" vechulei <small>(Vayikra 25 9)</small> "taaviru shofar". umippi hashshemua lamdu ma teruat yovel beshofar af teruat rosh hashshana beshofar: 
Bammikdash hayu tokin berosh hashshana beshofar echad ushete chatzotzrot min hatztzedadin. hashshofar maarich vehachatzotzrot mekatztzerot shemmitzvat hayyom beshofar. velamma tokin immo bachatzotzrot mishshum shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 98 6)</small> "bachatzotzrot vekol shofar hariu lifne hammelech Adonai". aval bishar mekomot en tokin berosh hashshana ella beshofar bilvad: 
Shofar shel akkum en tokin bo lechattechilla veim taka yatza. veshel ir hanniddachat im taka bo lo yatza. shofar haggazul shettaka bo yatza sheen hammitzva ella bishmiat hakkol af al pi shello naga bo velo higbiho hashshomea yatza veen bakkol din gezel. vechen shofar shel ola lo yitka bo veim taka yatza sheen bakkol din meila. veim tomar vahalo nehena bishmiat hakkol. mitzvot lo lehanot nittenu. lefichach hammuddar hanaya mishshofar muttar litkoa bo tekia shel mitzva: 
Shofar shel rosh hashshana en mechallelin alav et yom tov vaafillu bedavar shehu mishshum shevut. ketzad. haya hashshofar berosh hailan o meever hannahar veen lo shofar ella hu eno ole bailan veeno shat al pene hammayim kede lahavio. veen tzarich lomar sheen chotchin oto o osin bo melacha. mippene shettekiat shofar mitzvat ase veyom tov ase velo taase veen ase doche lo taase vaase. muttar litten betocho mayim o yayin o chometz beyom tov kede letzachtzecho. velo yitten letocho me raglayim leolam mippene hakkavod shello yihyu mitzvot bezuyot alav: 
Shiur hashshofar kede sheyyochazennu beyado veyerae lechan ulechan. nisdak learko pasul. lerachbo im nishtayyer bo kashshiur kasher ucheillu nichrat mimmekom hassedek. nikkav im setamo shello bemino pasul. setamo bemino im nishtayyer rubbo shalem velo ikkevu hannekavim shennistemu et hattekia hare ze kasher. kedacho bezichruto kasher shemmin bemino eno chotzetz. dibbek shivre shofarot ad shehishlimo leechad pasul: 
Hosif alav kol shehu ben bemino ben shello bemino pasul. tzippahu zahav mibbifnim o bimkom hannachat pe pasul. tzippahu mibbachutz im nishtanna kolo mikkemot shehaya pasul veim lo nishtanna kasher. natan shofar betoch shofar im kol penimi shama yatza veim kol chitzon shama lo yatza. hirchiv et hakkatzar vekitztzer et harachav pasul: 
Haya aroch vekitztzero kasher. gerdo ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz afillu heemido al gildo kasher. haya kolo av o dak o tzarur kasher shekkol hakkolot kesherin beshofar: 
Hattokea betoch habbor o betoch hammeara. otan haomdim betoch habbor vehammeara yatzu. vehaomdim bachutz im kol shofar shamu yatzu. veim kol havara shamu lo yatzu. vechen hattokea letoch chavit gedola vechayyotze bah. im kol shofar shama yatza veim kol havara shama lo yatza:

Hakkol chayyavin lishmoa kol shofar kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim vegerim vaavadim meshuchrarim. aval nashim vaavadim uketannim peturin. mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin vetumtum veanderoginus chayyavin: 
Kol mi sheeno chayyav baddavar eno motzi et hachayyav yede chovato. lefichach ishsha o katan shettaku bashshofar hashshomea mehen lo yatza. anderoginus motzi et mino veeno motzi et sheeno mino. tumtum eno motzi lo et mino velo sheeno mino. shehattumtum shennikra efshar sheyyimmatze zachar veefshar sheyyimmatze nekeva: 
Vechen mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin eno motzi afillu atzmo sheen tzad avdut shebbo motzi tzad cherut shebbo. ella ketzad yetze yede chovato. sheyyishma mibben chorin sheyyitka lo: 
Hammitassek bitkiat shofar lehitlammed lo yatza yede chovato. vechen hashshomea min hammitassek lo yatza. nitkavven shomea latzet yede chovato velo nitkavven hattokea lehotzio o shennitkavven hattokea lehotzio velo nitkavven hashshomea latzet lo yatza yede chovato. ad sheyyitkavven shomea umashmia: 
Mi shettaka venitkavven lehotzi kol hashshomea tekiato veshama hashshomea venitkavven latzet yede chovato af al pi sheen hattokea mitkavven leze peloni sheshshama tekiato veeno yodo yatza. shehare nitkavven lechol mi sheyyishmaennu. lefichach mi shehaya mehallech badderech o yoshev betoch beto veshama hattekiot mishsheliach tzibbur yatza im nitkavven latzet. shehare sheliach tzibbur mitkavven lehotzi et harabbim yede chovatan: 
Yom tov shel rosh hashshana shechal lihyot beshabbat en tokin bashshofar bechol makom. af al pi shehattekia mishshum shevut umin haddin haya shettokin yavo ase shel tora veyidche shevut shel divrehem. velamma en tokin gezera shemma yittelennu beyado veyolichennu lemi sheyyitka lo veyaavirennu arba ammot birshut harabbim. o yotzio mershut lirshut veyavo lide issur sekila. shehakkol chayyavim bitkia veen hakkol bekiin litkoa: 
Hattinokot shello higgiu lechinnuch en meakkevin otan millitkoa beshabbat sheenah yom tov shel rosh hashshana kede sheyyilmedu. umuttar legadol sheyyitassek immahen kede lelammedan beyom tov. ben katan shehiggia lechinnuch ben katan shello higgia lechinnuch. shehattekia enah asura ella mishshum shevut: 
Kesheggazru shello litkoa beshabbat lo gazru ella bemakom sheen bo bet din. aval bizman shehaya hammikdash kayyam vehaya bet din haggadol birushalayim hayu hakkol tokin birushalayim beshabbat kol zeman shebbet din yoshvin. velo anshe yerushalayim bilvad ella kol ir shehayta betoch techum yerushalayim vehayta roa yerushalayim lo shettihye betoch hannachal. vehayta shomaat kol tekiat yerushalayim lo shettihye berosh hahar. vehayta yechola lavo birushalayim lo sheyyihye nahar mafsik benehem. anshe otah hair hayu tokim beshabbat kirushalayim. aval bishar are yisrael lo hayu tokin: 
Uvazzeman hazze shecharav hammikdash kol makom sheyyesh bo bet din kavua vehu sheyyihye samuch beeretz yisrael tokin bo beshabbat. veen tokin beshabbat ella bevet din shekkiddeshu et hachodesh aval shear batte dinin en tokin bahen af al pi shehen semuchin. veen tokin ella bifne bet din gadol bilvad kol zeman shehen yoshvin vaafillu ninaru laamod velo amdu tokin bifnehem. aval chutz levet din en tokin. velamma tokin bifne bet din mippene shebbet din zerizin hen velo yavou hattokin lehaavir hashshofar bifnehem birshut harabbim shebbet din mazhirin et haam umodiin otan: 
Bazzeman hazze sheanu osin shene yamim baggalut kederech shettokin berishon tokin besheni. veim chal yom rishon lihyot beshabbat velo haya bammakom bet din haruyin litkoa tokin besheni bilvad:
